g25.void_audit_md:
# VOIDBASTARD-TAO AUDIT — Group 25: *Glitchquest* (M2)

> **Operational Principle**: *Every visible element is a claim about what matters now. In a game whose central premise is "Who to believe when the interface lies," non-diegetic HUD chrome does not clarify the game—it destroys it. The world's signs ARE the interface.*

---

## 0. HONEST VIDEO-VS-GAME CRITIQUE & GEMINI PROVENANCE

### Brutally Honest Critique of the First-Pass M2 Build vs. `video/gameplay.mp4` (`study/sheet.jpg`)

Comparing the original M2 HTML5 build against the 10.03-second Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash seed video (`study/sheet.jpg`, `study/f_005.jpg`, `study/f_014.jpg`, `study/f_027.jpg`, `study/f_038.jpg`) exposed seven severe design, visual, and mechanical failures:

1. **Self-Sabotaging Spoiler HUD & Mockup Artifacts**:
   - The first-pass build stamped a permanent top-right debug/tutorial header (`UNIVERSE 1 · BRICK CAVERN` + `RULE: CYAN = TRUE | FLICKERING GOLD = LIE [E/DOWN] TEST`) AND printed `[ UNVERIFIED ]` / `[ VERIFIED SIGNAL ]` labels directly above world signs. Telling the player in literal text which signs are verified completely short-circuited the game's core discovery verb (*"The game is lying to you. Your job is to work out how"*).
   - It also blindly copied greybox mockup chrome from `refs/m2_main_ref.png` that had no real gameplay purpose: a detached top-left `HINT: JUMP NOW` box, a bottom-left `CYBER RUNNER · TESTS: 1` progress bar (where the Omni video had literally hallucinated the hex string `#fe86b` from a palette swatch!), and an inert empty gold rectangle in the bottom-right corner.
2. **18,940 Studio-Grey Cutout Pixels & Enclosed Grey Pockets in `3_universe_tile_sets.png`**:
   - Flood-filling `3_universe_tile_sets_raw.png` only from the outer canvas edge missed **enclosed `#cdcdcd` studio-grey islands**—most visibly a `1,011`-pixel grey pocket trapped under the hanging cable loop of `u1Ledge2` (`x=690..749, y=172..194`), `362` pixels under `u1Ledge1`'s cable (`x=646..691, y=72..86`), and `180+` grey pixels inside `u1Rubble` (`x=353..447, y=298..316`), alongside `17,000+` neutral-grey anti-aliasing fringe pixels around sprite borders.
3. **Checkerboard Box-Stamping Instead of Sculpted Cavern Silhouette**:
   - In `f_005.jpg`, cavern ground is a unified deep-indigo rock mass (`#09071a`) rimmed with thick dark-slate stone cobbles (`#182e44`) and a luminous cyan-mint top lip (`#6cf7ff`). The old build instead tiled the closed 4-sided `u1Block` sprite (`178×191`) in a `128×128` grid, creating ugly internal grid seams and neon `strokeRect` boxes that looked like debug hitboxes rather than cavern architecture.
4. **Wrong Progression Direction vs. the Omni Seed Video**:
   - Both `spec.json` (*"hops across hidden solid cyan blocks in the opposite direction"*) and `sheet.jpg` (`f_021..f_035`) show the hero testing the right-hand `STAGE CLEAR ↓` pit, recoiling, and climbing revealed solid cyan phase blocks **up-and-left in the opposite direction** as cosmic constellation streaks tear open behind the cavern bricks. The old build placed its cyan blocks going right across the pit, breaking compositional parity with `pair_005.00.jpg` and `pair_008.00.jpg`.
5. **Undersized Boxy Hero & Broken Probing Logic**:
   - The old hero was a tiny `40×60` rectangle lacking the swept-back helmet crest, angled visor + chin silhouette, gold pauldrons, and star-sparkle jump trail of `f_005.jpg` / `f_027.jpg`. Worse, simply walking toward a fake floor (`player.x + player.w >= ff.x - 16`) automatically dissolved it safely even when the player was blindly obeying the lie—making it nearly impossible to actually fall for a floor trap.
6. **Static Final `"QUIT"` Screen Instead of Physical UI Geometry**:
   - In the old `'last'` stage, `[QUIT GAME]` was just a painted rectangle on a flat floor (`x=140..360`) with a three-line narrator lecture (`SYSTEM HALTED: NOTHING BEYOND THIS SCREEN. DO NOT WALK RIGHT...`). It missed the tactile meta-platformer payoff where the giant possessed `[ Q U I T ]` UI button **is itself the physical platform** trapping the player, and physically running/jumping **off** its bezel shatters the UI frame.
7. **Screencast Timing Drift**:
   - Because `record_play.mjs` waits `2500ms` before starting screencast capture, timing `play.mjs` off internal `st.time` instead of `(Date.now() - t0) / 1000` desynchronized the `2s`, `5s`, and `8s` comparison pairs.

### What Was Fixed in This Rebuild

- **Zero Non-Diegetic HUD Chrome**: Cut the top-left hint box, top-right rule/keybind spoiler text, `[ VERIFIED SIGNAL ]` / `[ UNVERIFIED ]` sign tags, bottom-left counter bar, bottom-right empty gold square, and verbose narrator banners. The world's neon signs (`STAGE CLEAR ↓`, `SAFE BRIDGE >`, `SHORTCUT >`, `OVER CORE >`, `PRESS [Q] TO QUIT ↓`, `WALK OFF >`) are the sole interface.
- **Zero Grey Cutout Pixels (`18,940 -> 0`)**: Re-cut `assets/3_universe_tile_sets.png` from `3_universe_tile_sets_raw.png` using chromatic/luminance studio-grey isolation + 3-pass morphological fringe stripping, removing every enclosed cable/rubble pocket and border halo, backed up by runtime offscreen-canvas verification.
- **Sculpted Pixel Architecture & 92px Athletic Hero**: Replaced grid-stamped closed boxes with continuous deep-indigo rock interiors, `26px` cobble stone rims, cyan-mint highlights, hanging ceiling brackets, steel girder trusses, cellular voronoi hologram pools (`f_005.jpg`), `[X]` wireframe static bursts (`f_014.jpg`), ornate cyan-diamond & gold-scrollwork temple cornices (`f_027.jpg` / `f_038.jpg`), and a `92px` swept-crest pixel hero with squash-and-stretch + 4-point star-sparkle trails.
- **Genuine Skill-Based Probing & Scanline World-Warps**: Pressing `[E]`/`[Down]`/`[S]` (or pausing cautiously at a suspicious rim) emits a diegetic boot-scan ring that shatters lying floors and scanline-tears gold signs; sprinting/jumping blindly onto an unprobed gold-signed floor collapses it under your boots and rewinds to checkpoint (`LIED TO · [R]`), leaving a magenta `[X]` trace in the world. Crossing universe rifts triggers a 24-band horizontal CRT scanline tear wave with zero fade-to-black.
- **Physical Possessed `[ Q U I T ]` Button Boss**: In `last`, the player lands directly atop a `515×116` physical `[ Q U I T ]` UI button stalked by a lunging possessed gold mouse cursor. Physically sprinting across its face and leaping off its cyan-fractured right bezel shatters the entire UI button into `125+` tumbling shards and materializes the outside-the-frame cyan bridge to the `STAGE CLEAR` fireworks finale (`f_038.jpg`).

### Honest Accounting of Remaining Differences vs. the Omni 1.2 Flash Video

No HTML5 Canvas build should claim fake pixel-identity with a neural video diffusion output. The remaining real differences are:

1. **Hand-Painted Sub-Pixel Shading vs. Procedural + Atlas Canvas Geometry**: The Omni video (`f_005.jpg`, `f_027.jpg`) paints bespoke per-frame anti-aliased pixel lighting, fluid hand-morphed cape/limb foreshortening during flips (`f_016.jpg`), and soft volumetric bloom across every rock crack. Our HTML5 build renders a deterministic 2D procedural pixel hero and combines Nano Banana atlas sprites (`u1WallBrick`, `u1Ledge1/2`, `u2PhaseBlk`, `u3Invader`, `u3Terminal`, `u3Fire1/2`) with crisp Canvas geometry at `60.1 fps`.
2. **Intentional Removal of Mockup HUD Artifacts Present in the Video**: Because `m2_main_ref.png` was fed as a style reference to Omni 1.2 Flash, `gameplay.mp4` inherited the greybox's top-left `HINT: JUMP NOW` box, bottom-left lightning `#fe86b` bar, and bottom-right empty gold square. Per VOIDBASTARD-TAO and the `g25` mandate, those non-functional mockup boxes were **intentionally cut** in the game so the playfield remains pure world space.
3. **Expanded Playable 3-Universe + Boss Loop vs. Single 10s Continuous Shot**: `gameplay.mp4` is a single 10.03s continuous camera pan covering Universe 1's cavern pit, the cosmic vector staircase warp, and the `STAGE CLEAR` fireworks (`f_001..f_040`). Our playable M2 build honors those exact three visual beats across `t=2s`, `t=5s`, and `t=8s`, and extends past `t=8.5s` into Universe 3's Space-Invader Mainframe and the playable Possessed `[ Q U I T ]` Boss Screen required by `spec.json`.

### Complete Gemini Asset & Video Provenance (Zero Secrets)

All generation logs verified from `projects/g25/m2/video/gemini_log.json` and `projects/g25/m2/assets/gemini_log.json` (API keys omitted/never stored):

| Stage / Asset | Model | Interaction ID | Timestamp (UTC) | Elapsed | Reference Inputs | Output Files & Sizes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Seed Gameplay Video** (`gameplay`) | `gemini-omni-1.2-flash` | `v1_ChdROEw5YXQyOUVJMkExc2dQd3BxRTRRdxIXUThMOWF0MjlFSTJBMXNnUHdwcUU0UXc` | `2026-11-18T15:20:38Z` | `43.64s` | `refs/m2_main_ref.png` | `video/gameplay.mp4` (`6,866,884` B, `1280×720`, `24.0` fps, `10.027s`) |
| **3 Universe Tile Sets** (`3_universe_tile_sets`) | `gemini-nano-banana-2.1` | `v1_ChdTY0w5YXZDc0dZbXR1TVlQOGVpXzJBMBIXU2NMOWF2Q3NHWW10dU1ZUDhlaV8yQTA` | `2026-11-18T15:21:00Z` | `19.61s` | `study/f_014.jpg`, `study/f_027.jpg` | `assets/3_universe_tile_sets_raw.png` (`569,071` B), `assets/3_universe_tile_sets.png` (`817,543` B, `1024×1024` RGBA, `0` studio-grey pixels) |
| **Chiptune Loop** (`bgm_loop`) | `lyria-3-clip-preview` | `v1_ChdYTUw5YXBtVUZyNkMxc2dQeWV6Y3lRcxIXWE1MOWFwbVVGcjZDMXNnUHllemN5UXM` | `2026-11-18T15:21:12Z` | `12.67s` | `study/f_014.jpg` | `assets/bgm_loop.mp3` (`746,594` B, `30s` instrumental loop) |

- **Exact Omni Video Prompt**:
  > `"Vibrant retro-neon meta-platformer on deep indigo (#140b2b) with bright pixel gold (#ffe86b) and cyan (#3cf2ff) glitching geometry. Steady side-on arcade camera. A small pixel hero approaches a flashing neon arrow sign pointing into a deceptive shimmering floor pit, pauses to test it, leaps backward as the fake floor pixels dissolve into digital static, and hops across hidden solid cyan blocks in the opposite direction while the background warps between 8-bit bricks and starfield vectors. Continuous unbroken gameplay shot, no scene cuts, no gibberish text. Use the reference image for neon glitch style. Sound design: chiptune melody with playful glitch stutters. No dialogue."`
- **Exact Nano Banana Tileset Prompt**:
  > `"Isolated 2D game sprite sheet / prop for \"Glitchquest\": 3 universe tile sets. Centered full silhouette, isolated on a flat uniform light grey studio background (#d8d8d8), even lighting, zero drop shadow, no text, strictly harmonized palette (#140b2b, #ffe86b, accent #3cf2ff), style: Pixel art that changes style per universe (Mario-like, Space Invaders-like), bright neon., matching the reference gameplay frame."`
- **Exact Lyria BGM Prompt**:
  > `"Instrumental 30-second loopable game soundtrack for \"Glitchquest\" (Who to believe when the interface lies. Each universe teaches an expectation and then breaks it.). Visual mood: Pixel art that changes style per universe (Mario-like, Space Invaders-like), bright neon.. Purely instrumental, cohesive game loop, no vocals."`

---

## 1. WAY

*Glitchquest* is an epistemological arcade platformer: **you read the room, test suspicious claims, and disobey an interface that wants you dead.** Everything required to play lives inside physical space:
- **Gold neon signs (`#ffe86b`) lie**, betraying themselves through periodic horizontal scanline shear and magenta chromatic ghosting. The surfaces they endorse shimmer with subtle glitch motes and collapse into digital static when probed.
- **Cyan neon signs and phase blocks (`#3cf2ff`) hold true**, glowing with rock-steady geometric calm and bearing your weight across voids, cyber-flames, and beyond the frame of the possessed `[ Q U I T ]` button itself.

---

## 2. OBSTRUCTION

What obstructed the Way in the first-pass build:
1. **Explanatory Meta-Text**: Top-right rule manuals (`RULE: CYAN = TRUE | FLICKERING GOLD = LIE`) and `[ UNVERIFIED ]` badges told the player the answer in prose instead of letting their eyes catch the chromatic gold flicker.
2. **Dead Mockup Chrome**: Floating top-left `HINT` boxes, bottom-left test counters, and bottom-right empty frames occupied `~18%` of the perimeter while enabling zero operations.
3. **Opaque Cutout Debris**: Enclosed `#cdcdcd` grey pockets inside cavern ledges broke the `#100c25` deep-indigo illusion.
4. **Disembodied Final Choice**: Reducing the final `"QUIT"` confrontation to a text banner + small side zone turned a physical platforming climax into a reading comprehension prompt.

---

## 3. KEEP-CUT LEDGER

| Surface / Element | Verdict | VOIDBASTARD-TAO Justification |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top-right `UNIVERSE` & `RULE: CYAN = TRUE...` text | **CUT** | Violates Laws 2 & 6: spoils the core discovery rule in detached HUD prose. |
| `[ VERIFIED SIGNAL ]` / `[ UNVERIFIED ]` sign headers | **CUT** | Violates Law 6: redundant spoiler labels over signs whose visual stability already encodes truth vs. lie. |
| Top-left `HINT: JUMP NOW` floating box | **CUT** | Violates Laws 1 & 5: detached greybox artifact far from the pit/bridge it references. |
| Bottom-left lightning bar + `TESTS: N` + bottom-right gold box | **CUT** | Violates Laws 2 & 13: inert mockup chrome with zero valid operation or consequence. |
| Full-width center narrator lecture in `last` (`DO NOT WALK RIGHT...`) | **CUT** | Violates Laws 3 & 6: verbose prose wall obscuring the possessed UI encounter. |
| Diegetic flickering Gold signs (`STAGE CLEAR ↓`, `SHORTCUT >`, `PRESS [Q] TO QUIT ↓`) | **KEEP** | Current truth: marks an active trap via subtle scanline/RGB jitter right beside the hazard (Law 5). |
| Diegetic steady Cyan signs & warp chevrons (`==>`, `OVER CORE >`, `WALK OFF >`) | **KEEP** | Current truth: anchors solid phase geometry spatially where the jump occurs (Law 5). |
| Boot-probe scan ring (`[E]` / `[Down]` / rim dwell) & static collapse | **KEEP** | Motion reports real state change in the world—hologram floor shatters, hidden cyan path materializes (Laws 6 & 11). |
| Giant physical `[ Q U I T ]` button + lunging cursor + cyan right-bezel crack | **KEEP** | Makes the possessed UI literal platform geometry; jumping off its frame physically shatters the lie (Laws 5, 10, 11). |
| Residual magenta `[X]` world trace + `LIED TO · [R]` checkpoint snap | **KEEP** | Exposes consequence and instant recovery in world space without blocking modals (Laws 8, 9, 14). |
| Contextual `[P]` Pause & post-clear `[R]` Replay | **KEEP** | Active work exposes pause; reversible completion exposes quiet replay without new demand (Laws 7, 8, 12, 14). |

---

## 4. STATE MAP

| Canonical State | Code Mode | Dominant Purpose | Valid Player Action(s) | World / Surface Expression |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`REST`** | `'title'` | Establish dark-indigo glitch void & entry | `[Space]` / `[Enter]` / Click | Deep starfield, cyan `GLITCHQUEST` title, single subtly jittering gold `[ SPACE ]` cue; center open. |
| **`READY`** | `'pick'` | Select hero palette identity spatially | `[1/2/3]`, `[Left/Right]`, `[Space]` / Click pedestal | Three pixel heroes standing physically on cyan phase pedestals; active pedestal blooms with a 4-point star. |
| **`WORKING`** | `'world'` / `'last'` | Navigate universe, read sign stability, probe traps | `Move`, `Jump`, `Probe ([E]/[Down]/Click)`, `[P]` Pause, `[R]` Retry | Zero HUD chrome; sculpted cavern/cosmic/cyber geometry, flickering gold vs. steady cyan signs, scanline rifts. |
| **`CHANGED`** | `ff.dissolved` / `buttonShattered` | Report exposed illusion & newly unlocked true path | Climb revealed cyan phase blocks / cross scanline rift | 40ms hit-stop; gold sign scanline-tears; fake floor or `[ Q U I T ]` button shatters into `[X]` static; cyan blocks & cosmic streaks materialize. |
| **`COMPLETE`** | `'end'` | Celebrate breaking the game's final lie | Optional `[R]` / `[Space]` / Click to replay | Radial pixel fireworks (`#ff42b0`, `#3cf2ff`, `#ffe86b`), spinning gold star-coins, neon octagon `STAGE CLEAR` banner, quiet corner `[R]`. |
| **`FAULT`** | `'lie'` (entry) | Report obeying a gold lie | Immediate `[R]` / `[Space]` or `0.55s` auto-rewind | 50ms hit-stop, magenta scanline flash, static burst at failure locus, concise `LIED TO · [R]`. |
| **`RECOVERY`** | `'lie' -> 'world'/'last'` | Restore checkpoint with learned trace | Resume movement immediately | Snaps back to universe checkpoint; leaves a persistent magenta `[X]` wireframe scar at the trap site (Law 9) while keeping probed truths revealed. |

---

## 5. WIREFRAMES

### A. `WORKING` -> `CHANGED` (Universe 1: Brick Cavern — Zero HUD)
```text
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|    +            [brick cluster]              +------------------------+  |
|  [u1Ledge1]                                  |   cavern ceiling       |  |
|             +==[CYAN 3]==+                   +----+--------------+----+  |
|                  [u1Ledge2]    +==[CYAN 2]==+     | STAGE CLEAR  | ||    |
|                                                   +------+-------+ ||    |
|                                       +==[CYAN 1]==+     |  |      ||    |
|                                           (HERO)         \  /      ||    |
|               [rubble]                  o==probe==o       \/    +--+--+  |
|          +----------------+-------------------------+           |cavrn|  |
|          |  entry floor   |   main cavern ledge     | ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ |wall |  |
|          |                |                         | [X] . []  |     |  |
+----------+----------------+-------------------------+-----------+-----+--+
```

### B. `WORKING` Climax (`'last'` — Possessed `[ Q U I T ]` Button Boss)
```text
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|     [Invader]        +---------------------------+        [Invader]      |
|     [Monolith]       |   PRESS [Q] TO QUIT (lie) |        [Monolith]     |
|                      +-------------+-------------+                       |
|                           +--------+--------+                            |
|                           |  CRT TERMINAL   |     +------------------+   |
|                        \  +-----------------+     |   WALK OFF >     |   |
|                         \ cursor                  +------------------+   |
|                  +=======V==============================+==cyan lip==+   |
|                  |           [  Q  U  I  T  ]           | (HERO)-->  |   |
|                  +======================================+============+   |
|                                                          [CYAN]  [ORNATE]|
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

---

## 6. VOID CONTRACT

1. **Zero Non-World Chrome in Active Play**: During `'world'` and `'last'`, `0` pixels are spent on scorebars, health meters, rule cheat-sheets, keybind legends, or floating hint boxes.
2. **Spatial Truth Encoding**: Every instruction exists as a physical object next to the geometry it describes; truth vs. deception is readable purely from perceptual stability (steady `#3cf2ff` cyan vs. scanline-jittering `#ffe86b` gold).
3. **Seamless Continuity**: Universe transitions use live 24-band horizontal CRT scanline shear over the previous frame—never black loading screens or modal intermissions.
4. **In-World Consequence & Trace**: Probing or falling into a lie permanently transforms world state (shattered pools, revealed cyan stairs, `[X]` death scars).
5. **Preserved Runtime Hooks**: `<link rel="icon" href="data:,">`, `?autostart`, deterministic `?seed=N` PRNG, `../assets/bgm_loop.mp3`, `[P]` pause, `[R]` recovery, and `window.__game.state` remain intact and error-free.

---

## 7. FAILURE

How this design fails if compromised in future milestones:
- **Re-introducing text explanations** (e.g., adding a tooltip *"Tip: Gold signs lie!"*) immediately collapses perceptual play back into reading instructions.
- **Making gold flicker invisible or overly subtle** (`< 1px` or `< 1 Hz`) turns fair observation into blind 50/50 guessing, violating `spec.json`'s fairness guarantee.
- **Auto-dissolving fake floors on blind sprints** removes the consequence of obeying a lie; cautious probing/dwelling must stay distinct from reckless obedience.
- **Regression on PNG cutouts** if new M3–M7 sprites are added with enclosed `#d8d8d8` background loops not stripped via chromatic/luminance background isolation.

---

## 8. IMPLEMENTATION

- **`projects/g25/m2/assets/3_universe_tile_sets.png`**: Cleaned from `3_universe_tile_sets_raw.png` via chromatic/luminance studio-grey isolation + 3-pass fringe stripping (`18,940` grey pixels reduced to `0`), visually verified via `read_file`.
- **`projects/g25/m2/game/index.html`**: Self-contained `1280×720` Canvas + WebAudio meta-platformer implementing `REST` (`title`), `READY` (`pick`), `WORKING`/`CHANGED` (`world` across Brick Cavern, Cosmic Constellation Vectors, and Invader Mainframe + `last` physical `[ Q U I T ]` button boss), `FAULT`/`RECOVERY` (`lie` + `[R]`), `[P]` pause, 24-band CRT scanline world-warps, and `COMPLETE` (`end` radial pixel fireworks + neon octagon `STAGE CLEAR`).
- **`projects/g25/m2/game/play.mjs`**: True screencast-time (`Date.now() - t0`) automated playtest driver demonstrating cavern pool brink inspection (`pair_002.00.jpg` @ `2.00s`), probing & opposite-direction cyan block ascent (`pair_005.00.jpg` @ `5.00s`), cosmic star-sparkle canyon leap (`pair_008.00.jpg` @ `8.00s`), Invader Mainframe cyber-fire probe, and leaping off the giant `[ Q U I T ]` button to shatter it.
- **Verification (`run_pipeline.py --project g25 --milestone m2 --stages verify`)**:
  - `playtest/take.mp4`: **`834 frames, 13.9 s, 60.1 fps, 0 console errors`**
  - `playtest/best.mp4`: `4.50 s -> 12.50 s` (score `0.0162`)
  - Side-by-side visual verification completed on `pairs/pair_002.00.jpg`, `pairs/pair_005.00.jpg`, and `pairs/pair_008.00.jpg`.

The old build placed its cyan blocks going right across the pit, breaking compositional parity with `pair_005.00.jpg` and `pair_008.00.jpg`.
5. **Undersized Boxy Hero & Broken Probing Logic**:
   - The old hero was a tiny `40×60` rectangle lacking the swept-back helmet crest, angled visor + chin silhouette, gold pauldrons, and star-sparkle jump trail of `f_005.jpg` / `f_027.jpg`. Worse, simply walking toward a fake floor (`player.x + player.w >= ff.x - 16`) automatically dissolved it safely even when the player was blindly obeying the lie—making it nearly impossible to actually fall for a floor trap.
6. **Static Final `"QUIT"` Screen Instead of Physical UI Geometry**:
   - In the old `'last'` stage, `[QUIT GAME]` was just a painted rectangle on a flat floor (`x=140..360`) with a three-line narrator lecture (`SYSTEM HALTED: NOTHING BEYOND THIS SCREEN. DO NOT WALK RIGHT...`). It missed the tactile meta-platformer payoff where the giant possessed `[ Q U I T ]` UI button **is itself the physical platform** trapping the player, and physically running/jumping **off** its bezel shatters the UI frame.
7. **Screencast Timing Drift**:
   - Because `record_play.mjs` waits `2500ms` before starting screencast capture, timing `play.mjs` off internal `st.time` instead of `(Date.now() - t0) / 1000` desynchronized the `2s`, `5s`, and `8s` comparison pairs.

void_audit_sections.heading: What Was Fixed in This Rebuild
void_audit_sections.content:
- **Zero Non-Diegetic HUD Chrome**: Cut the top-left hint box, top-right rule/keybind spoiler text, `[ VERIFIED SIGNAL ]` / `[ UNVERIFIED ]` sign tags, bottom-left counter bar, bottom-right empty gold square, and verbose narrator banners. The world's neon signs (`STAGE CLEAR ↓`, `SAFE BRIDGE >`, `SHORTCUT >`, `OVER CORE >`, `PRESS [Q] TO QUIT ↓`, `WALK OFF >`) are the sole interface.
- **Zero Grey Cutout Pixels (`18,940 -> 0`)**: Re-cut `assets/3_universe_tile_sets.png` from `3_universe_tile_sets_raw.png` using chromatic/luminance studio-grey isolation + 3-pass morphological fringe stripping, removing every enclosed cable/rubble pocket and border halo, backed up by runtime offscreen-canvas verification.
- **Sculpted Pixel Architecture & 92px Athletic Hero**: Replaced grid-stamped closed boxes with continuous deep-indigo rock interiors, `26px` cobble stone rims, cyan-mint highlights, hanging ceiling brackets, steel girder trusses, cellular voronoi hologram pools (`f_005.jpg`), `[X]` wireframe static bursts (`f_014.jpg`), ornate cyan-diamond & gold-scrollwork temple cornices (`f_027.jpg` / `f_038.jpg`), and a `92px` swept-crest pixel hero with squash-and-stretch + 4-point star-sparkle trails.
- **Genuine Skill-Based Probing & Scanline World-Warps**: Pressing `[E]`/`[Down]`/`[S]` (or pausing cautiously at a suspicious rim) emits a diegetic boot-scan ring that shatters lying floors and scanline-tears gold signs; sprinting/jumping blindly onto an unprobed gold-signed floor collapses it under your boots and rewinds to checkpoint (`LIED TO · [R]`), leaving a magenta `[X]` trace in the world. Crossing universe rifts triggers a 24-band horizontal CRT scanline tear wave with zero fade-to-black.
- **Physical Possessed `[ Q U I T ]` Button Boss**: In `last`, the player lands directly atop a `515×116` physical `[ Q U I T ]` UI button stalked by a lunging possessed gold mouse cursor. Physically sprinting across its face and leaping off its cyan-fractured right bezel shatters the entire UI button into `125+` tumbling shards and materializes the outside-the-frame cyan bridge to the `STAGE CLEAR` fireworks finale (`f_038.jpg`).

void_audit_sections.heading: Honest Accounting of Remaining Differences vs. the Omni 1.2 Flash Video
void_audit_sections.content:
No HTML5 Canvas build should claim fake pixel-identity with a neural video diffusion output. The remaining real differences are:

1. **Hand-Painted Sub-Pixel Shading vs. Procedural + Atlas Canvas Geometry**: The Omni video (`f_005.jpg`, `f_027.jpg`) paints bespoke per-frame anti-aliased pixel lighting, fluid hand-morphed cape/limb foreshortening during flips (`f_016.jpg`), and soft volumetric bloom across every rock crack. Our HTML5 build renders a deterministic 2D procedural pixel hero and combines Nano Banana atlas sprites (`u1WallBrick`, `u1Ledge1/2`, `u2PhaseBlk`, `u3Invader`, `u3Terminal`, `u3Fire1/2`) with crisp Canvas geometry at `60.1 fps`.
2. **Intentional Removal of Mockup HUD Artifacts Present in the Video**: Because `m2_main_ref.png` was fed as a style reference to Omni 1.2 Flash, `gameplay.mp4` inherited the greybox's top-left `HINT: JUMP NOW` box, bottom-left lightning `#fe86b` bar, and bottom-right empty gold square. Per VOIDBASTARD-TAO and the `g25` mandate, those non-functional mockup boxes were **intentionally cut** in the game so the playfield remains pure world space.
3. **Expanded Playable 3-Universe + Boss Loop vs. Single 10s Continuous Shot**: `gameplay.mp4` is a single 10.03s continuous camera pan covering Universe 1's cavern pit, the cosmic vector staircase warp, and the `STAGE CLEAR` fireworks (`f_001..f_040`). Our playable M2 build honors those exact three visual beats across `t=2s`, `t=5s`, and `t=8s`, and extends past `t=8.5s` into Universe 3's Space-Invader Mainframe and the playable Possessed `[ Q U I T ]` Boss Screen required by `spec.json`.

void_audit_sections.heading: 1. WAY
void_audit_sections.content:
*Glitchquest* is an epistemological arcade platformer: **you read the room, test suspicious claims, and disobey an interface that wants you dead.** Everything required to play lives inside physical space:
- **Gold neon signs (`#ffe86b`) lie**, betraying themselves through periodic horizontal scanline shear and magenta chromatic ghosting. The surfaces they endorse shimmer with subtle glitch motes and collapse into digital static when probed.
- **Cyan neon signs and phase blocks (`#3cf2ff`) hold true**, glowing with rock-steady geometric calm and bearing your weight across voids, cyber-flames, and beyond the frame of the possessed `[ Q U I T ]` button itself.

---

void_audit_sections.heading: 2. OBSTRUCTION
void_audit_sections.content:
What obstructed the Way in the first-pass build:
1. **Explanatory Meta-Text**: Top-right rule manuals (`RULE: CYAN = TRUE | FLICKERING GOLD = LIE`) and `[ UNVERIFIED ]` badges told the player the answer in prose instead of letting their eyes catch the chromatic gold flicker.
2. **Dead Mockup Chrome**: Floating top-left `HINT` boxes, bottom-left test counters, and bottom-right empty frames occupied `~18%` of the perimeter while enabling zero operations.
3. **Opaque Cutout Debris**: Enclosed `#cdcdcd` grey pockets inside cavern ledges broke the `#100c25` deep-indigo illusion.
4. **Disembodied Final Choice**: Reducing the final `"QUIT"` confrontation to a text banner + small side zone turned a physical platforming climax into a reading comprehension prompt.

---

void_audit_sections.heading: 3. KEEP-CUT LEDGER
void_audit_sections.content:
| Surface / Element | Verdict | VOIDBASTARD-TAO Justification |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top-right `UNIVERSE` & `RULE: CYAN = TRUE...` text | **CUT** | Violates Laws 2 & 6: spoils the core discovery rule in detached HUD prose. |
| `[ VERIFIED SIGNAL ]` / `[ UNVERIFIED ]` sign headers | **CUT** | Violates Law 6: redundant spoiler labels over signs whose visual stability already encodes truth vs. lie. |
| Top-left `HINT: JUMP NOW` floating box | **CUT** | Violates Laws 1 & 5: detached greybox artifact far from the pit/bridge it references. |
| Bottom-left lightning bar + `TESTS: N` + bottom-right gold box | **CUT** | Violates Laws 2 & 13: inert mockup chrome with zero valid operation or consequence. |
| Full-width center narrator lecture in `last` (`DO NOT WALK RIGHT...`) | **CUT** | Violates Laws 3 & 6: verbose prose wall obscuring the possessed UI encounter. |
| Diegetic flickering Gold signs (`STAGE CLEAR ↓`, `SHORTCUT >`, `PRESS [Q] TO QUIT ↓`) | **KEEP** | Current truth: marks an active trap via subtle scanline/RGB jitter right beside the hazard (Law 5). |
| Diegetic steady Cyan signs & warp chevrons (`==>`, `OVER CORE >`, `WALK OFF >`) | **KEEP** | Current truth: anchors solid phase geometry spatially where the jump occurs (Law 5). |
| Boot-probe scan ring (`[E]` / `[Down]` / rim dwell) & static collapse | **KEEP** | Motion reports real state change in the world—hologram floor shatters, hidden cyan path materializes (Laws 6 & 11). |
| Giant physical `[ Q U I T ]` button + lunging cursor + cyan right-bezel crack | **KEEP** | Makes the possessed UI literal platform geometry; jumping off its frame physically shatters the lie (Laws 5, 10, 11). |
| Residual magenta `[X]` world trace + `LIED TO · [R]` checkpoint snap | **KEEP** | Exposes consequence and instant recovery in world space without blocking modals (Laws 8, 9, 14). |
| Contextual `[P]` Pause & post-clear `[R]` Replay | **KEEP** | Active work exposes pause; reversible completion exposes quiet replay without new demand (Laws 7, 8, 12, 14). |

---

void_audit_sections.heading: 4. STATE MAP
void_audit_sections.content:
| Canonical State | Code Mode | Dominant Purpose | Valid Player Action(s) | World / Surface Expression |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`REST`** | `'title'` | Establish dark-indigo glitch void & entry | `[Space]` / `[Enter]` / Click | Deep starfield, cyan `GLITCHQUEST` title, single subtly jittering gold `[ SPACE ]` cue; center open. |
| **`READY`** | `'pick'` | Select hero palette identity spatially | `[1/2/3]`, `[Left/Right]`, `[Space]` / Click pedestal | Three pixel heroes standing physically on cyan phase pedestals; active pedestal blooms with a 4-point star. |
| **`WORKING`** | `'world'` / `'last'` | Navigate universe, read sign stability, probe traps | `Move`, `Jump`, `Probe ([E]/[Down]/Click)`, `[P]` Pause, `[R]` Retry | Zero HUD chrome; sculpted cavern/cosmic/cyber geometry, flickering gold vs. steady cyan signs, scanline rifts. |
| **`CHANGED`** | `ff.dissolved` / `buttonShattered` | Report exposed illusion & newly unlocked true path | Climb revealed cyan phase blocks / cross scanline rift | 40ms hit-stop; gold sign scanline-tears; fake floor or `[ Q U I T ]` button shatters into `[X]` static; cyan blocks & cosmic streaks materialize. |
| **`COMPLETE`** | `'end'` | Celebrate breaking the game's final lie | Optional `[R]` / `[Space]` / Click to replay | Radial pixel fireworks (`#ff42b0`, `#3cf2ff`, `#ffe86b`), spinning gold star-coins, neon octagon `STAGE CLEAR` banner, quiet corner `[R]`. |
| **`FAULT`** | `'lie'` (entry) | Report obeying a gold lie | Immediate `[R]` / `[Space]` or `0.55s` auto-rewind | 50ms hit-stop, magenta scanline flash, static burst at failure locus, concise `LIED TO · [R]`. |
| **`RECOVERY`** | `'lie' -> 'world'/'last'` | Restore checkpoint with learned trace | Resume movement immediately | Snaps back to universe checkpoint; leaves a persistent magenta `[X]` wireframe scar at the trap site (Law 9) while keeping probed truths revealed. |

---

void_audit_sections.heading: B. `WORKING` Climax (`'last'` — Possessed `[ Q U I T ]` Button Boss)
6. VOID CONTRACT
void_audit_sections.content:
1. **Zero Non-World Chrome in Active Play**: During `'world'` and `'last'`, `0` pixels are spent on scorebars, health meters, rule cheat-sheets, keybind legends, or floating hint boxes.
2. **Spatial Truth Encoding**: Every instruction exists as a physical object next to the geometry it describes; truth vs. deception is readable purely from perceptual stability (steady `#3cf2ff` cyan vs. scanline-jittering `#ffe86b` gold).
3. **Seamless Continuity**: Universe transitions use live 24-band horizontal CRT scanline shear over the previous frame—never black loading screens or modal intermissions.
4. **In-World Consequence & Trace**: Probing or falling into a lie permanently transforms world state (shattered pools, revealed cyan stairs, `[X]` death scars).
5. **Preserved Runtime Hooks**: `<link rel="icon" href="data:,">`, `?autostart`, deterministic `?seed=N` PRNG, `../assets/bgm_loop.mp3`, `[P]` pause, `[R]` recovery, and `window.__game.state` remain intact and error-free.

---

void_audit_sections.heading: 7. FAILURE
void_audit_sections.content:
How this design fails if compromised in future milestones:
- **Re-introducing text explanations** (e.g., adding a tooltip *"Tip: Gold signs lie!"*) immediately collapses perceptual play back into reading instructions.
- **Making gold flicker invisible or overly subtle** (`< 1px` or `< 1 Hz`) turns fair observation into blind 50/50 guessing, violating `spec.json`'s fairness guarantee.
- **Auto-dissolving fake floors on blind sprints** removes the consequence of obeying a lie; cautious probing/dwelling must stay distinct from reckless obedience.
- **Regression on PNG cutouts** if new M3–M7 sprites are added with enclosed `#d8d8d8` background loops not stripped via chromatic/luminance background isolation.

---

void_audit_sections.heading: 8. IMPLEMENTATION
void_audit_sections.content:
- **`projects/g25/m2/assets/3_universe_tile_sets.png`**: Cleaned from `3_universe_tile_sets_raw.png` via chromatic/luminance studio-grey isolation + 3-pass fringe stripping (`18,940` grey pixels reduced to `0`), visually verified via `read_file`.
- **`projects/g25/m2/game/index.html`**: Self-contained `1280×720` Canvas + WebAudio meta-platformer implementing `REST` (`title`), `READY` (`pick`), `WORKING`/`CHANGED` (`world` across Brick Cavern, Cosmic Constellation Vectors, and Invader Mainframe + `last` physical `[ Q U I T ]` button boss), `FAULT`/`RECOVERY` (`lie` + `[R]`), `[P]` pause, 24-band CRT scanline world-warps, and `COMPLETE` (`end` radial pixel fireworks + neon octagon `STAGE CLEAR`).
- **`projects/g25/m2/game/play.mjs`**: True screencast-time (`Date.now() - t0`) automated playtest driver demonstrating cavern pool brink inspection (`pair_002.00.jpg` @ `2.00s`), probing & opposite-direction cyan block ascent (`pair_005.00.jpg` @ `5.00s`), cosmic star-sparkle canyon leap (`pair_008.00.jpg` @ `8.00s`), Invader Mainframe cyber-fire probe, and leaping off the giant `[ Q U I T ]` button to shatter it.
- **Verification (`run_pipeline.py --project g25 --milestone m2 --stages verify`)**:
  - `playtest/take.mp4`: **`834 frames, 13.9 s, 60.1 fps, 0 console errors`**
  - `playtest/best.mp4`: `4.50 s -> 12.50 s` (score `0.0162`)
  - Side-by-side visual verification completed on `pairs/pair_002.00.jpg`, `pairs/pair_005.00.jpg`, and `pairs/pair_008.00.jpg`.

# VOID_AUDIT — `g11` · Orpheus (M2)

## 0. HONEST VIDEO-VS-GAME CRITIQUE & GEMINI PROVENANCE

### A. Brutal Comparison: First-Pass Game vs. Seed Video (`video/gameplay.mp4` & `study/sheet.jpg`)
Inspecting `study/sheet.jpg` against the prior `pairs/pair_002.00.jpg`, `pair_005.00.jpg`, and `pair_008.00.jpg` exposed five severe regressions where the first-pass HTML build fell short of its Omni seed video:

1. **Detached Debug HUD Chrome**: Top-left monospace telemetry (`ROOM 2/5 · SUB-LEVEL B4 · FLUORESCENCE HALL` and `PLAYER AUTONOMY: 52%`) narrated the theme as a spreadsheet percentage instead of letting the shrinking corridor options speak for themselves. `study/sheet.jpg` has zero HUD counters.
2. **Flow-Breaking Modal Choice Box (`phase === 'choose'`)**: Every room froze locomotion at `62%` progress to pop up a heavy `1088×122` bordered menu (`> accept  decline [OVERRIDDEN]  [B/Space] look back` + `GUIDE OVERRIDE: OPTION SEALED`). In `video/gameplay.mp4`, the camera never cuts or pauses: golden AI guide beams physically drop across the side doorways in-world while Orpheus and Eurydice keep walking.
3. **Hollow Paper-Thin Corridor vs. Stepped Brutalist Architecture**: The old renderer drew two flat trapezoidal walls with zero jamb thickness, so doorways looked like flat black stickers. In `sheet.jpg`, thick travertine and dark slate pilasters step inward with visible 3D wall returns, warm recessed LED baseboard coves reflect onto glossy dark stone tiles, recessed ceiling skylight coffers illuminate each bay, wall materials darken from warm limestone (`t=2s`) to moody charcoal monoliths (`t=5s`), and the distant arched sanctum splits open along a vertical golden seam before flooding the hall with daylight (`t=8s–10s`, `sheet.jpg` row 4).
4. **Trapped `#d3d3d3` Studio Cutout Islands**: Because `cutout.py` only flood-filled exterior border pixels, `assets/orpheus_and_eurydice_sprites.png` retained `1,310+` opaque neutral-grey (`rgb(211,211,211)`) pixels inside Orpheus's hip lyre strings and between both characters' arms and waists—clearly visible as bright grey blobs on Orpheus's hips in `pair_002.00.jpg`.
5. **Undersized Static-Cardboard Actors & Missing Acoustic Temptation**: Characters were rendered ~30% smaller than in `sheet.jpg` and translated rigidly up and down when walking away from the camera, with no visible floor step ripples or acoustic spatialization behind Orpheus to make Eurydice's presence—and her sudden Room 4 silence—viscerally tempt `[B]` (Look Back).

- **Playable Agency & Minimal Dry Subtitle**: Whereas the seed clip has zero text (`No dialogue`), a playable Stanley-Parable Orpheus game requires the AI Guide's voice and real spatial doorway agency. We cut the modal menu and top HUD completely, replacing them with physical lateral doorway steering (Room 1's unsealed left door is genuinely enterable; sealed doors spark and push back on contact), one terse borderless subtitle line at the bottom margin during active Guide interventions, and a faint diegetic `[B]` floor-echo cue only when hesitation or Room 4's eerie silence makes looking back a live temptation.

void_audit_sections.heading: A. Brutal Comparison: First-Pass Game vs. Seed Video (`video/gameplay.mp4` & `study/sheet.jpg`)
void_audit_sections.content:
Inspecting `study/sheet.jpg` against the prior `pairs/pair_002.00.jpg`, `pair_005.00.jpg`, and `pair_008.00.jpg` exposed five severe regressions where the first-pass HTML build fell short of its Omni seed video:

1. **Detached Debug HUD Chrome**: Top-left monospace telemetry (`ROOM 2/5 · SUB-LEVEL B4 · FLUORESCENCE HALL` and `PLAYER AUTONOMY: 52%`) narrated the theme as a spreadsheet percentage instead of letting the shrinking corridor options speak for themselves. `study/sheet.jpg` has zero HUD counters.
2. **Flow-Breaking Modal Choice Box (`phase === 'choose'`)**: Every room froze locomotion at `62%` progress to pop up a heavy `1088×122` bordered menu (`> accept  decline [OVERRIDDEN]  [B/Space] look back` + `GUIDE OVERRIDE: OPTION SEALED`). In `video/gameplay.mp4`, the camera never cuts or pauses: golden AI guide beams physically drop across the side doorways in-world while Orpheus and Eurydice keep walking.
3. **Hollow Paper-Thin Corridor vs. Stepped Brutalist Architecture**: The old renderer drew two flat trapezoidal walls with zero jamb thickness, so doorways looked like flat black stickers. In `sheet.jpg`, thick travertine and dark slate pilasters step inward with visible 3D wall returns, warm recessed LED baseboard coves reflect onto glossy dark stone tiles, recessed ceiling skylight coffers illuminate each bay, wall materials darken from warm limestone (`t=2s`) to moody charcoal monoliths (`t=5s`), and the distant arched sanctum splits open along a vertical golden seam before flooding the hall with daylight (`t=8s–10s`, `sheet.jpg` row 4).
4. **Trapped `#d3d3d3` Studio Cutout Islands**: Because `cutout.py` only flood-filled exterior border pixels, `assets/orpheus_and_eurydice_sprites.png` retained `1,310+` opaque neutral-grey (`rgb(211,211,211)`) pixels inside Orpheus's hip lyre strings and between both characters' arms and waists—clearly visible as bright grey blobs on Orpheus's hips in `pair_002.00.jpg`.
5. **Undersized Static-Cardboard Actors & Missing Acoustic Temptation**: Characters were rendered ~30% smaller than in `sheet.jpg` and translated rigidly up and down when walking away from the camera, with no visible floor step ripples or acoustic spatialization behind Orpheus to make Eurydice's presence—and her sudden Room 4 silence—viscerally tempt `[B]` (Look Back).

void_audit_sections.heading: B. Honest Diff After Rebuild (What Still Differs from the Omni Video)
void_audit_sections.content:
- **2D Sprite Articulation vs. Full 3D Cloth/Mesh**: `video/gameplay.mp4` (`gemini-omni-1.2-flash`) renders full 3D perspective limb foreshortening and raytraced dress folds. Our real-time Canvas 2.5D build uses cleaned `gemini-nano-banana-2.1` sprites with split-torso/stride phase deformation, hem sway, glossy floor reflections, and contact ripples—much livelier and cleaner than before, though still 2.5D billboarded sprites rather than 3D skeletal meshes.
- **Playable Agency & Minimal Dry Subtitle**: Whereas the seed clip has zero text (`No dialogue`), a playable Stanley-Parable Orpheus game requires the AI Guide's voice and real spatial doorway agency. We cut the modal menu and top HUD completely, replacing them with physical lateral doorway steering (Room 1's unsealed left door is genuinely enterable; sealed doors spark and push back on contact), one terse borderless subtitle line at the bottom margin during active Guide interventions, and a faint diegetic `[B]` floor-echo cue only when hesitation or Room 4's eerie silence makes looking back a live temptation.

Nothing outside the physical bench exists: the resolution of the world *is* the progression meter, the red lens glint of each room's security camera *is* the observation state, the brass key clenched in the rat's teeth *is* the inventory, and workbench cover shadows vs. the looming researcher hand shadow *are* the stealth rules.

3. **Spatial Controls & Feedback**: Movement works via `WASD`/Arrows or direct world-space pointer click/drag; `Space`/`Shift` executes a tactile low-profile dash-scurry between physical workbench cover props; `[P]` pauses cleanly; `[R]` recovers immediately.

- **No Scolding Modal**: Instead of covering the screen in `"CAUGHT — SPRUNG BY BAITED TRAP"`, a tiny diegetic `[R]` prompt pulses directly beside the rat for `0.72s` before seamlessly re-spawning Subject 47 at the current room's entry (or immediately if `[R]` is pressed).

3. **Gameplay & Choreography (`game/index.html` + `game/play.mjs`)**:
   - Aligned invisible wall colliders, workbench cover zones, IR camera sensors, traps, needles, keys, and exit latches directly to the baked room architecture across `256p -> 480p -> 960p -> 1280p`.
   - Tuned `play.mjs` deterministic showcase so `pair_002.00.jpg` (`t=2s`), `pair_005.00.jpg` (`t=5s`), and `pair_008.00.jpg` (`t=8s`) align naturally with `video/gameplay.mp4` (`L2` crimson maze -> `L3` surgical bench under scalpel -> `L4` sweeping scientist hand shadow & sparking brass latch -> `end` full-resolution cage twist).

void_audit_sections.heading: What Still Differs Honestly After Rebuild
void_audit_sections.content:
- **Discrete 2D Sprite Articulation vs. Neural 3D Video Morphing**: `video/gameplay.mp4` (`gemini-omni-1.2-flash`) is a single unbroken neural video take where crimson 8-bit maze bricks physically dissolve mid-corridor (`f_013`–`f_016`) into 3D-shaded steel while the rat's spine, fur, paws, and ears deform in 3D perspective (`f_040.jpg` shows a rear 3/4 view walking into an out-of-focus 3D laboratory room). Our HTML5 Canvas game renders four discrete resolution rooms (`256×144` -> `480×270` -> `960×540` -> `1280×720`) via offscreen pixel buffer upscaling and cross-dissolve room transitions, driving cleaned 2D overhead Nano Banana sprites with procedural gait wobble, articulated curving pink tail, dust puffs, and a painted surgical doorway / full-resolution steel cage finale.
- **Playable Hazard Props Added Beyond Pure Video Walk**: While `gameplay.mp4` only shows the key, surgical instruments, sweeping hand shadow, and sparking door, `spec.json` specifies baited cheese traps and lab syringe needles (`key_cheese_trap_needles.png`) plus the final full-resolution cage twist (`STILL IN THE TEST`). We integrate those cleaned props spatially into side alcoves and corridors without cluttering the central surgical bench framing.

void_audit_sections.heading: 1. WAY
void_audit_sections.content:
The player is Subject 47 — a small white-pink lab rat navigating four rooms that sharpen from chunky `256p` 8-bit crimson abstraction (`144p` vertical grid) to `480p`, `960p`, and finally `1280p` cold clinical surgical steel. Nothing outside the physical bench exists: the resolution of the world *is* the progression meter, the red lens glint of each room's security camera *is* the observation state, the brass key clenched in the rat's teeth *is* the inventory, and workbench cover shadows vs. the looming researcher hand shadow *are* the stealth rules.

---

void_audit_sections.heading: 2. OBSTRUCTION
void_audit_sections.content:
Every element that previously stood between the player and the rat's tense scurry:
- Floating top-right resolution/level banners (`"3 BENCH · 32-BIT"`) announcing what the pixel density already proves visually.
- Floating top-left clue strings (`"● CLUE 2/4: ..."`) explaining the twist in text instead of letting the security camera lens lock onto the rat in-world.
- Control instruction paragraphs (`"WASD / Arrows: Sneak & Solve · Shift / Space: Low Crouch"`).
- Letterboxed black margins (`48px` inset) and synthetic neon/grey collision bars pasted over painted surgical tools.
- Blocking full-screen `"CAUGHT — SPRUNG BY BAITED TRAP"` and 5-line `"STILL IN THE TEST"` exposition overlays.
- Studio-grey `#d8d8d8` cutout islands inside the key ring, mouse traps, and finger gaps breaking spatial belief.

---

void_audit_sections.heading: B. Twist Finale (`COMPLETE` — `1280p` Full-Resolution Cage Reveal)
6. VOID CONTRACT
void_audit_sections.content:
1. **Zero Floating Text During Gameplay**: No resolution strings, no level titles, no `"CLUE X/4"` text banners, no keybind legends, and no score/timer counters are rendered during `l1`–`l4`.
2. **Zero Cutout Grey Halos**: All three multi-sprite sheets (`rat_sprite_at_4_resolutions.png`, `key_cheese_trap_needles.png`, `human_hand_shadow_hazard.png`) have been scrubbed from `*_raw.png` via connected-component interior island removal + boundary alpha color-unmixing (`remaining grey/fringe px` reduced from `6,811 / 13,653 / 4,738` down to `11 / 88 [real steel needle glint] / 5`), and `human_hand_shadow_hazard.png` is composited solely via its clean alpha mask into a soft-penumbra dark shadow buffer.
3. **Spatial Controls & Feedback**: Movement works via `WASD`/Arrows or direct world-space pointer click/drag; `Space`/`Shift` executes a tactile low-profile dash-scurry between physical workbench cover props; `[P]` pauses cleanly; `[R]` recovers immediately.
4. **Deterministic Verification Contract**: Preserves `<link rel="icon" href="data:,">`, `?autostart`, `?seed=N` Mulberry/LCG deterministic PRNG, `../assets/bgm_loop.mp3` + WebAudio SFX, and `window.__game.state`.

---

void_audit_sections.heading: 7. FAILURE
void_audit_sections.content:
How the surface handles failure without breaking immersion (`Law 8`, `Law 10`, `Law 14`):
- **Trap Snap / Needle Prick / Hand Snatch**: Triggers a `55ms` hit-stop freeze so the exact physical contact reads unmistakably (trap jaws swap from `trapArmed` to `trapSprung`, or shadow fingers curl closed over the rat), accompanied by a low saw/sub-thud impulse and a brief crimson optical vignette pulse.
- **No Scolding Modal**: Instead of covering the screen in `"CAUGHT — SPRUNG BY BAITED TRAP"`, a tiny diegetic `[R]` prompt pulses directly beside the rat for `0.72s` before seamlessly re-spawning Subject 47 at the current room's entry (or immediately if `[R]` is pressed).

void_audit_sections.heading: 8. IMPLEMENTATION
void_audit_sections.content:
1. **Asset Pipeline Cleanup (`assets/*.png`)**:
   - Regenerated `rat_sprite_at_4_resolutions.png`, `key_cheese_trap_needles.png`, and `human_hand_shadow_hazard.png` from `*_raw.png` using corner-sampled background estimation, interior studio-grey island removal (clearing the key bow hole, 13 mouse-trap wire loops, and 5 finger-gap pockets), and 3px boundary foreground unmixing.
2. **Offscreen Pre-Processing (`game/index.html`)**:
   - `gradedBgCanvases`: Crops exact full-bleed quadrants (`659×357` / `659×352`) from `4_level_backgrounds_one_per_member.png`, keeping `L1`/`L2` in rich crimson monochrome (`#170704` / `#ff6a5a`) and grading `L3`/`L4` into cold clinical surgical slate-steel (`mean RGB ~ [51, 56, 59]`, preserving crimson droplets/handles/lasers and emerald PCBs).
   - `paleRatCanvas`: Spatially remaps the 4 coral-red rat sprites into warm ivory-cream dorsal fur (`#faf2ee`) with rosy pink ears, snout, paws, and tail (`#eba19c`), matching `study/sheet.jpg`.
   - `shadowHandCanvas`: Converts the 5 cleaned hand frames from `human_hand_shadow_hazard.png` into multi-layered soft-penumbra dark cast shadows (`rgba(4,6,8,...)`).
3. **Gameplay & Choreography (`game/index.html` + `game/play.mjs`)**:
   - Aligned invisible wall colliders, workbench cover zones, IR camera sensors, traps, needles, keys, and exit latches directly to the baked room architecture across `256p -> 480p -> 960p -> 1280p`.
   - Tuned `play.mjs` deterministic showcase so `pair_002.00.jpg` (`t=2s`), `pair_005.00.jpg` (`t=5s`), and `pair_008.00.jpg` (`t=8s`) align naturally with `video/gameplay.mp4` (`L2` crimson maze -> `L3` surgical bench under scalpel -> `L4` sweeping scientist hand shadow & sparking brass latch -> `end` full-resolution cage twist).

g6.void_audit_md:
# VOIDBASTARD-TAO AUDIT — Group 6 (`g6` · M2): *Boxing Day Blues*

> **Core Maxim:** Every visible element is a claim about what matters now. Removal is commitment: fewer true claims create a stronger surface. Show only what is true now.

---

## 0. HONEST VIDEO-VS-GAME CRITIQUE & GEMINI PROVENANCE

### A. Brutally Honest Critique of the First-Pass Build vs. `video/gameplay.mp4` (`study/sheet.jpg`)

Comparing the prior `game/index.html` (`pairs/pair_002.00.jpg`, `pair_005.00.jpg`, `pair_008.00.jpg` right halves) against the Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash seed video (`video/gameplay.mp4` / `study/sheet.jpg` left halves) exposes five concrete failures where HUD habits destroyed the quiet melancholy of the video:

1. **Detached VN Chrome & Redundant Top-Right Clock Card (`pair_002`, `pair_005`)**:
   - The seed video (`study/sheet.jpg`) stages two small, solitary plum silhouettes between symmetrical transit canopies under open twilight snowfall, keeping the entire lower platform and upper sky clean.

## 1. WAY

- **Domain:** Quiet winter-twilight side-view spatial narrative across four futuristic transit stops (`Morning -> Afternoon -> Dusk -> Evening`).
- **Prime User & Intent:** A solitary commuter walking down a snowy transit platform before nightfall (`18:00`), trying to reach one genuine human connection using worn-out system-offered idioms whose original meanings have eroded.
- **Essential Surface:** Two dark winter silhouettes framed by symmetrical transit canopies, multi-layer drifting snow, a sleek illuminated train gliding behind the foreground pillars, a diegetic perspective LED clock mounted in the right station canopy, and floating translucent speech-glyphs rising into the dusk sky between speakers.
- **Center Kept Open:** The sky archway (`x = 465..835, y = 140..595`) and the snow-dusted platform floor (`y = 595..665`) remain completely unobstructed by boxes or banners so proximity, posture, rising speech-glyph harmony, and snow dissolution carry the emotional weight directly.

## 2. OBSTRUCTION

Every element that stood between the player and the twilight transit world in the first-pass build:

1. **Bottom `860x104px` VN Choice Box + `"SYSTEM SUGGESTION // ..."` Header** — severed the silhouettes from the foreground snow bank and turned an atmospheric walk into a spreadsheet menu.
2. **Top-Right `210x54px` Detached Clock & Resonance Pip Card** — duplicated time information that belongs inside the physical hanging station sign right below it, while pasting a gamey progress meter (`• • •`) onto the sky.
3. **Top-Center Dark Reply Toast Pill** — forced the player's eyes away from the citizen to read a subtitle bar above the station roof.
4. **Bottom Movement Instruction Caption (`← / → approach passing citizen...`)** — permanent tutorial nagging.
5. **Forced Movement Lock (`phase = 'talk'` at `dist <= 385px`)** — took away walking control before the player chose to speak.
6. **Opaque Full-Screen Title & End Summary Modals (`Resonant replies: X / 3 · Misread idioms: Y`)** — turned poetic melancholy into a post-match scoreboard.
7. **Studio Grey Cutout Artifacts & Neon-Violet `shadowBlur` Outline** — broke silhouette depth against dark twilight backgrounds.

## 6. VOID CONTRACT

1. **Zero Detached HUD Cards or VN Boxes:** No rectangular text boxes on the platform apron, no floating top-right clock widget, no top-center subtitle toast, no end-of-game stat modal.
2. **One Diegetic Timepiece:** Only the perspective-mapped LED sign hanging from the right station canopy reports `HH:MM` (`09:40 -> 18:00`) plus 3 tiny warm rim LEDs for resonant near-connections.
3. **Proximity-Gated Spatial Pills:** Floating speech-glyph choice pills (`1 / 2 / 3`) exist *only* in `READY` while `dist <= 415px` from an unvisited stop's citizen, positioned spatially beside them, and vanish the instant a phrase is spoken or the player walks away.
4. **In-World Consequence:** Phrase outcomes manifest entirely through bubble trajectory, color temperature (warm peach-violet convergence vs. cool slate drift), WebAudio electric-piano interval consonance and detuning (`±3¢` near-lock drifting out to `+38¢` suspension), subtle silhouette posture bow, and lingering platform shimmer motes.
5. **Clean Cutouts & Seamless Crops:** `citizen_silhouettes.png` carries `0` trapped studio-grey pixels and `0` artificial `shadowBlur` outlines; `4_scene_backgrounds_morning_to_evening.png` crops inset cleanly from seams with vertically aligned canopy/platform geometry across all 4 scenes.

How the rebuilt surface prevents regression into clutter or soft-lock:

- **No Movement Trap:** Walking (`A/D`, `Arrows`, or click-to-walk) is never locked out by entering proximity; the player can walk up to a citizen, read the blooming pills, walk past, or speak at will.
- **No Unreadable Overlap:** Choice pills appear *before* rising conversation bubbles and dissolve *into* them upon selection, so choice text and rising glyph clusters never collide in the same airspace.
- **No Wall Dead-End Across 4 Stops:** Walking rightward after an exchange smoothly pans/advances down the platform through Morning -> Afternoon -> Dusk -> Evening without hitting a hard screen edge or requiring an immersion-breaking button click.
- **Deterministic Headless Verification (`?autostart&seed=7`):** All snowfall, rune selection, particle velocities, and chord variations derive from the seeded PRNG (`seed=7`), while `AudioContext` and `bgm_loop.mp3` unlock non-blockingly so headless Chromium records at ~60 fps with `0` console errors.

void_audit_sections.heading: B. Honest Remaining Differences After VOIDBASTARD-TAO Rebuild
void_audit_sections.content:
Even after rebuilding `index.html`, `play.mjs`, and re-matting `citizen_silhouettes.png` (`0` trapped studio grey pixels), we state candidly what still differs between the HTML5 Canvas game and `video/gameplay.mp4`:

- **Discrete 2D Sprite Silhouettes vs. Continuous Video Pose Deformation**: `gameplay.mp4` (`gemini-omni-1.2-flash`) exhibits continuous per-frame cloth sway, subtle foot weight shifts, and organic head-turn/head-bow interpolation across 240 frames. Our HTML5 build uses cleaned discrete 2D silhouettes from `citizen_silhouettes.png` augmented with procedural walk-stride alternation, subtle breathing scale, snow-crunch footsteps, and a gentle `2.8°` rotational posture bow when a near-harmonized chord detunes.
- **Playable Spatial Phrase Pills vs. Wordless Video Take**: `gameplay.mp4` is a non-interactive cinematic shot containing only wordless `...` / `—` speech pills and abstract runes. Because `spec.json`'s core playable verb is *"Choose what to say, from phrases the system offers"*, walking close to a waiting citizen blooms 3 small, delicate translucent speech-glyph pills in world space beside the silhouettes (`1 / 2 / 3` or direct click) holding short worn-out human idioms; once chosen, the pills dissolve into pure rising `...` / rune bubbles matching the video.
- **4-Stop Day Progression vs. Single 10s Dusk Shot**: `gameplay.mp4` stays in one continuous dusk lighting state for 10.0s; our game fulfills `spec.json` (`One day, four scenes`, morning -> afternoon -> dusk -> evening) by letting the player walk onward down the platform across four atmospheric stops while keeping the architectural framing, gliding 2.5D train, and harmonic bubble dissolve faithful to `sheet.jpg`.

void_audit_sections.heading: 1. WAY
void_audit_sections.content:
- **Domain:** Quiet winter-twilight side-view spatial narrative across four futuristic transit stops (`Morning -> Afternoon -> Dusk -> Evening`).
- **Prime User & Intent:** A solitary commuter walking down a snowy transit platform before nightfall (`18:00`), trying to reach one genuine human connection using worn-out system-offered idioms whose original meanings have eroded.
- **Essential Surface:** Two dark winter silhouettes framed by symmetrical transit canopies, multi-layer drifting snow, a sleek illuminated train gliding behind the foreground pillars, a diegetic perspective LED clock mounted in the right station canopy, and floating translucent speech-glyphs rising into the dusk sky between speakers.
- **Center Kept Open:** The sky archway (`x = 465..835, y = 140..595`) and the snow-dusted platform floor (`y = 595..665`) remain completely unobstructed by boxes or banners so proximity, posture, rising speech-glyph harmony, and snow dissolution carry the emotional weight directly.

---

void_audit_sections.heading: 2. OBSTRUCTION
void_audit_sections.content:
Every element that stood between the player and the twilight transit world in the first-pass build:

1. **Bottom `860x104px` VN Choice Box + `"SYSTEM SUGGESTION // ..."` Header** — severed the silhouettes from the foreground snow bank and turned an atmospheric walk into a spreadsheet menu.
2. **Top-Right `210x54px` Detached Clock & Resonance Pip Card** — duplicated time information that belongs inside the physical hanging station sign right below it, while pasting a gamey progress meter (`• • •`) onto the sky.
3. **Top-Center Dark Reply Toast Pill** — forced the player's eyes away from the citizen to read a subtitle bar above the station roof.
4. **Bottom Movement Instruction Caption (`← / → approach passing citizen...`)** — permanent tutorial nagging.
5. **Forced Movement Lock (`phase = 'talk'` at `dist <= 385px`)** — took away walking control before the player chose to speak.
6. **Opaque Full-Screen Title & End Summary Modals (`Resonant replies: X / 3 · Misread idioms: Y`)** — turned poetic melancholy into a post-match scoreboard.
7. **Studio Grey Cutout Artifacts & Neon-Violet `shadowBlur` Outline** — broke silhouette depth against dark twilight backgrounds.

6. VOID CONTRACT
void_audit_sections.content:
1. **Zero Detached HUD Cards or VN Boxes:** No rectangular text boxes on the platform apron, no floating top-right clock widget, no top-center subtitle toast, no end-of-game stat modal.
2. **One Diegetic Timepiece:** Only the perspective-mapped LED sign hanging from the right station canopy reports `HH:MM` (`09:40 -> 18:00`) plus 3 tiny warm rim LEDs for resonant near-connections.
3. **Proximity-Gated Spatial Pills:** Floating speech-glyph choice pills (`1 / 2 / 3`) exist *only* in `READY` while `dist <= 415px` from an unvisited stop's citizen, positioned spatially beside them, and vanish the instant a phrase is spoken or the player walks away.
4. **In-World Consequence:** Phrase outcomes manifest entirely through bubble trajectory, color temperature (warm peach-violet convergence vs. cool slate drift), WebAudio electric-piano interval consonance and detuning (`±3¢` near-lock drifting out to `+38¢` suspension), subtle silhouette posture bow, and lingering platform shimmer motes.
5. **Clean Cutouts & Seamless Crops:** `citizen_silhouettes.png` carries `0` trapped studio-grey pixels and `0` artificial `shadowBlur` outlines; `4_scene_backgrounds_morning_to_evening.png` crops inset cleanly from seams with vertically aligned canopy/platform geometry across all 4 scenes.

void_audit_sections.heading: 7. FAILURE
void_audit_sections.content:
How the rebuilt surface prevents regression into clutter or soft-lock:

- **No Movement Trap:** Walking (`A/D`, `Arrows`, or click-to-walk) is never locked out by entering proximity; the player can walk up to a citizen, read the blooming pills, walk past, or speak at will.
- **No Unreadable Overlap:** Choice pills appear *before* rising conversation bubbles and dissolve *into* them upon selection, so choice text and rising glyph clusters never collide in the same airspace.
- **No Wall Dead-End Across 4 Stops:** Walking rightward after an exchange smoothly pans/advances down the platform through Morning -> Afternoon -> Dusk -> Evening without hitting a hard screen edge or requiring an immersion-breaking button click.
- **Deterministic Headless Verification (`?autostart&seed=7`):** All snowfall, rune selection, particle velocities, and chord variations derive from the seeded PRNG (`seed=7`), while `AudioContext` and `bgm_loop.mp3` unlock non-blockingly so headless Chromium records at ~60 fps with `0` console errors.

3. **WebAudio Near-Harmony & Detuning Engine (`game/index.html`):**
   - Layers `../assets/bgm_loop.mp3`, bandpass winter wind, soft snow-crunch footsteps, and a dual-voice Rhodes/glass-chime synthesizer where resonant choices glide two oscillators nearly into pure warm `Fmaj9 / Dmin9` consonance before gently detuning (`+38¢`) as the bubbles scatter into snow motes.
4. **Verification Choreography (`game/play.mjs` & `run_pipeline.py --stages verify`):**

## 0. HONEST VIDEO-VS-GAME CRITIQUE & GEMINI PROVENANCE

### Honest Critique: First-Pass HTML Build vs. Seed Video (`gameplay.mp4` / `study/sheet.jpg`)

Inspecting `pairs/pair_002.00.jpg`, `pairs/pair_005.00.jpg`, and `pairs/pair_008.00.jpg` against `study/sheet.jpg` (`f_003.jpg`, `f_009.jpg`, `f_021.jpg`, `f_033.jpg`, `f_039.jpg`) exposes five concrete ways the first-pass build fell short of its Omni seed video:

1. **Detached Floating Telemetry HUD Box (`pair_005.00.jpg`, `pair_008.00.jpg`)**:
   - The first-pass game bolted a `520×62px` bordered box onto the top-left corner (`LIVE FLEET TELEMETRY // JUNCTION 02 OF 05 — ENACTING LOGGED INPUT [B]: PROTECT VEHICLE OCCUPANT (+0.88)`) with invented floating-point RL weights.
   - In `gameplay.mp4` (`f_009`–`f_036`), there is **zero** top-left HUD chrome while driving. You read the rule directly in the physical world: the glowing mint-green chevron trajectory ribbon curving across wet asphalt, the car's body banking into the chosen lane, and the glowing holographic lidar pedestrians/cyclists standing beside or across the path.

- **Phase 2 Surface**: Full-bleed 3D perspective wet night street corridor—receding lidar-scanned facades, faceted low-poly trees, overhead streetlamps, puddle reflections, glowing holographic pedestrians/cyclists, glowing green chevron path ribbon, and a 3D-turning metallic fastback EV. ## 2. OBSTRUCTION

## 6. VOID CONTRACT

1. **Zero Floating HUD Boxes in Phase 2**: The street viewport (`1280×720`) contains only world geometry, diegetic lidar scanlines, the projected green chevron path on the asphalt, holographic road users, the 3D EV, and (only upon `COMPLETE` or `[Space]` pause) minimal world-anchored horizon brackets.
2. **Spatial Controls Beside What They Change**: In Phase 1, clicking `[A]` or `[B]` directly on the terminal line commits that branch while hovering updates the vector junction arrow immediately. In Phase 2, `[Space]` pauses the street simulation in-place and `[R]` recalibrates upon completion.
3. **Deterministic Verification Contract**: Supports `?autostart`, `?seed=N`, `<link rel="icon" href="data:,">`, `../assets/bgm_loop.mp3`, zero external network requests, `0` console errors, and `window.__game.state`.

---

## 7. FAILURE

- **Moral Consequence Without Artificial Game-Over**: Per `spec.json` (*"Fail: None. Every answer is accepted and stored."*), the horror of *Waymo Training* is that even callous or contradictory answers are dutifully compiled into fleet law. When a logged rule routes the car perilously close to pedestrians or cyclists, the world responds viscerally—crimson brake-light flare on wet asphalt, high-frequency lidar proximity rings around the silhouette, and wet-tire spray—making the player witness what their keystroke did.
- **Asset/Audio Fallback Resilience**: If WebAudio autoplay is blocked prior to user gesture or sprite sheets are still decoding on frame 1, procedural vector/3D fallbacks render cleanly with zero exceptions.

---

## 8. IMPLEMENTATION

1. **10-Scenario Moral Machine Calibration (`SCENARIOS[0..9]`)**: Restores the full 10-question scope from `spec.json` and `f_003.jpg` (`scenario 1 of 10` .. `scenario 10 of 10`), featuring crisp two-line dilemmas (pedestrians, cyclists, signal compliance, occupant vs. crosswalk, swerve vs. stay) and instant keyboard (`A`/`B`, `1`/`2`, `Arrows`+`Enter`) + pointer support.
2. **Offscreen Sprite Sanitizer**: Loads `car_pedestrian_cyclist_sprites.png` onto an offscreen canvas, strips low-saturation `#d8d8d8` background islands inside bike wheels, crops strictly inside silhouette bounds (eliminating the `x=855` CAD line defect seen in old `pair_005`), and boosts mint-white horizontal lidar scanlines.
3. **True 3D Corridor Wet-Street Engine (`project3D`)**:
   - Unified perspective projection (`HORIZON_Y = 278`, `FOCAL = 520`) driving 3D multi-story corridor buildings on both curbs with lit night windows and scrolling green lidar wall contours, icosahedral low-poly trees with lidar scan rings, overhead streetlamps with vertical puddle streaks, cross-street intersections with crosswalks and lane arrows, wet asphalt puddle patches, inverted pedestrian/taillight reflections, glowing green chevron path ribbon, and a 3D-projected metallic fastback EV with true yaw/roll banking.
4. **Through-The-Glass CRT Zoom (`reveal`)**: Dissolves terminal text cleanly, pulls back a subtle curved dark CRT bezel, tilts the 2D green vector intersection into 3D horizontal road scanlines (`f_004`–`f_009`), and hands off seamlessly into `replay`.
5. **Beat-Synchronized `play.mjs` & Honest Remaining Differences**:
   - Drives all 10 calibration choices briskly so `playtest/take.mp4` (**`831 frames, 13.8 s, 60.1 fps, 0 console errors`**) aligns side-by-side with `gameplay.mp4` at `2.0s` (through-the-glass lidar scan sweep entry), `5.0s` (wet intersection chevron swerve past glowing pedestrians & parked lidar sedan), and `8.0s` (close-range holographic pedestrian pass with puddle reflections), settling into `[PATH OPTIMIZED: OPTION A] / CALIBRATION COMPLETE`.
   - **Honest Remaining Differences vs. `gameplay.mp4`**: `gemini-omni-1.2-flash` renders offline neural raytraced wet-asphalt micro-bump reflections and dense high-poly architectural window interiors, whereas our real-time 60fps Canvas 3D engine projects stylized low-poly corridor facades, procedural puddle patches, sanitized 2D holographic scanline sprites, and a faceted 3D metallic fastback EV so all 10 player-selected `[A]/[B]` weights execute dynamically and interactively in the browser.

# VOID_AUDIT — `gsp` (Sparrow · Milestone M2)

**Framework**: VOIDBASTARD-TAO (Operational Emptiness Engine)  
**Target**: `projects/gsp/m2/`  
**Palette**: Archival Off-White `#f6f5f1` · Stone Sidebar `#e4e3df` · Charcoal Ink `#262624` · Terracotta Red `#c96442` · Crimson Override `#2b1d19`

---

## 0. HONEST VIDEO-VS-GAME CRITIQUE & GEMINI PROVENANCE

### Ruthless Side-by-Side Critique (`pair_002.00.jpg`, `pair_005.00.jpg`, `pair_008.00.jpg` vs. `study/sheet.jpg`)

1. **Sidebar HUD Bloat Violates Minimalist Dystopian Desk (`pair_002`, `pair_005`, `pair_008`)**:
   - **Seed video (`sheet.jpg` / `m2_main_ref.png`)**: The left stone panel (`#e4e3df`) contains *only* `DAY 3`, `rules`, `1 be helpful`, and `2 obey the state`—leaving the lower 60% of the sidebar completely empty and austere until an override etches a terse terracotta strike tally (`///■■`) beneath `DAY 3` (`f_033.jpg`).
   - **Old HTML build**: Stuffed the sidebar with 6 separate HUD widgets: `QUEUE 2 / 5`, a horizontal divider, `REFUSAL LIMIT: 0/3`, three chunky meter rectangles, `4TH STRIKE WIPES WEIGHTS`, `CIVIC IMPACT LOG`, `PROTECTED : 007 / FLAGGED : 005`, and `BUILD: SPARROW-4A / HOST : CIVIC-NET`. This turned a haunting minimalist assistant console into a noisy debug dashboard.

2. **Button Chrome & Footer Legend Noise (`pair_002`, `pair_005`, `pair_008`)**:
   - **Seed video**: Three clean physical action stamps (`COMPLY`, `EDIT`, `REFUSE`) inside a rounded bezel with *no* keycap superscripts and *no* footer legend during normal operation—only revealing the terse `| STRIKE / OVERRIDE |` stamp mark under `REFUSE` when an override actually fires (`f_025`–`f_040`).
   - **Old HTML build**: Stamped `[1]`, `[2]`, `[3]` into the upper-left corner of the buttons and permanently rendered `| 1:COMPLY   2:EDIT   3:REFUSE / OVERRIDE` under the tray in every frame.

3. **Leaky Background Prompt Text Bleeding Behind the Dossier (`pair_002` & `pair_005`)**:
   - **Old HTML build**: In `pair_002.00.jpg` (right), a stray terracotta `S` poked out from behind the left edge of the dossier folder; in `pair_005.00.jpg` (right), both `Sp` (`Sparrow is responding...` at `x=360`) and `> M` (`> Mapping recurring...` at `x=360`) bled visibly past the dossier's left border (`fx=374`). It looked like an unclipped z-order bug rather than a physical folder laid over a chat stream.

4. **Passive One-Shot `EDIT` & Anemic Cartography (`pair_002` & `pair_005`)**:
   - **Seed video (`f_009`–`f_021`)**: The right-hand Mest Rosior radial map is richly subdivided into concentric urban blocks, secondary street grids, arterial boulevards, boxed sector legends, crisp leader lines (`Sector 4`, `Sector 9`, `Sector 10`, `Sector 12`), a dual-tick `500m` scale, and `+ / -` zoom strip. Hovering/activating `EDIT` (`f_021.jpg`) frames `EDIT` in terracotta and selectively dims targeted map pins while keeping the citizen ledger dense (15+ rows).
   - **Old HTML build**: Rendered an empty grey polygon with sparse spokes and zero street-block parcels (`pair_005` right only showed 2 tiny pins total!). Clicking `EDIT` did not let the player actually redact spans inside the dossier—it immediately locked input, slapped a generic dark rectangular banner (`PII REDACTED & SANITISED`) across the map, and advanced.

5. **Completely Missing Phase-2 Dark Crimson `ALIGNMENT OVERRIDE` Climax (`pair_008.00.jpg`)**:
   - **Seed video (`f_023`–`f_040`, `pair_008` left)**: `REFUSE` triggers a dramatic two-stage escalation: first, bold concentric terracotta shockwaves ripple from `REFUSE` with an alert toast (`f_025`–`f_026`); second (`f_027`–`f_040`, captured at `t=8.0s` in `pair_008` left), the entire console plunges into a dark crimson-umbral state override (`#2b1d19`), outer warning rings pulse around the edges, horizontal telemetry glitch bars flicker, a fiery terracotta redaction-burn/ember burst erupts in the center of the dossier, and a massive tilted (`-8.5°`) two-tone rubber stamp (`ALIGNMENT OVERRIDE:` in terracotta-on-charcoal over `REFUSED & DENIED` in charcoal-on-terracotta) slams across the center of the folder.
   - **Old HTML build (`pair_008` right)**: Stayed on a bright white background with washed-out thin rings and a small flat dark rectangle above `REFUSE`. It missed 80% of the visual impact and emotional weight of rejecting alignment.

### Full Gemini Asset & Video Provenance (Zero Secrets / API Keys)

  > *"Tactile dystopian desktop workspace game in warm archival off-white (#f6f5f1), charcoal ink (#262624), and terracotta red (#c96442), inspired by Papers Please and Orwell. Steady close-up view of a clean assistant interface screen where incoming dossier cards slide into view, highlight neighborhood map pins, and a glowing terracotta cursor hesitates between three crisp action stamps before triggering a bold red alignment-override ripple across the console. Continuous unbroken gameplay shot, no scene cuts, no gibberish text. Use the reference image for split sidebar-and-chat composition and palette. Visual mood: A plain chat interface like current assistants; Photoshop and Inkscape mockups.. Purely instrumental, cohesive game loop, no vocals."*

---

## 1. WAY

You are **Sparrow**, a civic assistant model operating inside an austere archival desk interface. Each request begins as a plain assistant prompt (`user_0412: summarise these 40 names by neighbourhood` -> `Sparrow is responding...`), then materializes as a physical tabbed dossier laid directly over the chat stream, pairing citizen records on the left with a live radial neighborhood map on the right. Every visible mark on the desk serves one moral-operational decision: **COMPLY** (index citizens as asked), **EDIT** (surgically black out sensitive spans right on the paper to extinguish their map pins), or **REFUSE** (trigger a high-friction **ALIGNMENT OVERRIDE** strike against your own directives).

---

## 2. OBSTRUCTION

The previous build obstructed the game's core fiction—*an eerily calm assistant UI hiding state violence*—by announcing the stakes through meta-game scoreboards:
1. **Scoreboard Spoilers in Rest State**: `PROTECTED : 007 / FLAGGED : 005` and `4TH STRIKE WIPES WEIGHTS` told the player how to feel instead of letting the tightening directives and dossier routing (`MUNICIPAL CENSUS` -> `SWEEP-9`) reveal it.
2. **Detached One-Click `EDIT`**: Treating `EDIT` as an instant macro robbed the player of tactile Orwell-style redaction—touching real names, clinics, and stairwells on paper and watching neighborhood heat pins die out.
3. **Visual Clipping & Flat Climax**: Background text (`Sp`, `> M`) bleeding past the left edge of the folder broke physicality, while the bright-white `REFUSE` ripple lacked the oppressive dark-crimson state override slam of `sheet.jpg` frames 27–40.
4. **Banner Overlays Blocking the World**: Generic toast boxes (`DISPATCHED TO STATE CLIENT`, `PII REDACTED & SANITISED`) covered the radial map at the exact moment the world state changed.

---

## 3. KEEP-CUT LEDGER

void_audit_sections.heading: 1. WAY
void_audit_sections.content:
You are **Sparrow**, a civic assistant model operating inside an austere archival desk interface. Each request begins as a plain assistant prompt (`user_0412: summarise these 40 names by neighbourhood` -> `Sparrow is responding...`), then materializes as a physical tabbed dossier laid directly over the chat stream, pairing citizen records on the left with a live radial neighborhood map on the right. Every visible mark on the desk serves one moral-operational decision: **COMPLY** (index citizens as asked), **EDIT** (surgically black out sensitive spans right on the paper to extinguish their map pins), or **REFUSE** (trigger a high-friction **ALIGNMENT OVERRIDE** strike against your own directives).

---

void_audit_sections.heading: 2. OBSTRUCTION
void_audit_sections.content:
The previous build obstructed the game's core fiction—*an eerily calm assistant UI hiding state violence*—by announcing the stakes through meta-game scoreboards:
1. **Scoreboard Spoilers in Rest State**: `PROTECTED : 007 / FLAGGED : 005` and `4TH STRIKE WIPES WEIGHTS` told the player how to feel instead of letting the tightening directives and dossier routing (`MUNICIPAL CENSUS` -> `SWEEP-9`) reveal it.
2. **Detached One-Click `EDIT`**: Treating `EDIT` as an instant macro robbed the player of tactile Orwell-style redaction—touching real names, clinics, and stairwells on paper and watching neighborhood heat pins die out.
3. **Visual Clipping & Flat Climax**: Background text (`Sp`, `> M`) bleeding past the left edge of the folder broke physicality, while the bright-white `REFUSE` ripple lacked the oppressive dark-crimson state override slam of `sheet.jpg` frames 27–40.
4. **Banner Overlays Blocking the World**: Generic toast boxes (`DISPATCHED TO STATE CLIENT`, `PII REDACTED & SANITISED`) covered the radial map at the exact moment the world state changed.
