   - `sheet.jpg` has a completely open upper walnut counter between `SCORE 360 / COMBO x2` (top-left) and `LIVES ***` (top-right).  
   - The old build bolted on a top-center `NYE 11:52:25 PM · 12/31/1999` clock bar AND four boxed `[1] T1 | [2] T2 | [3] T3 | [4] T4` HUD widgets (`y = 36..94`). Worse, in `pair_008.00.jpg`, the floating callout `T2 SERVED! +200` spawned at `y = 118` and drifted straight over the `[2] T2` and `[3] T3` boxes, producing illegible overlapping text.
   - Over the cutting track itself, the old build spammed `HYPER x4! +160` (`pair_002`), `HYPER x8! +200` (`pair_005`), and `6 PCS READY! SERVE TABLE T2 [ENTER / 2]` (`pair_008`), plus `HYPER COMBO x4 / x8 / x12` in yellow at top-left. `sheet.jpg` has **zero** floating combat-text popups over the knife and uses understated `COMBO x2..x5` in warm coral (`#e86a42`) that blooms softly on cut impact (`f_007.jpg`).

2. **Flow-Breaking Manual Table-Serve Interrupt (`state === 'serve'`)**  
   - In `gameplay.mp4` (`sheet.jpg` frames 1–24), gameplay is an unbroken Rhythm-Heaven / Cooking-Mama cutting cadence: maki rolls glide onto the board, the blade slices portions on the beat, and the bottom-right Y2K receipt printer automatically advances paper slips (`ORDER COMPLETE` in frame 23–24).  
   - The old build halted cutting after every single roll to demand a manual `[ENTER / 1..4]` table-routing step (`pair_008`), turning a tactile rhythm cutter into a stop-and-go menu chore.

3. **Muddy Grey-Brown Cutout Spark Blob (`SPR.burstFlash`) vs. Crisp 360° Spark Streaks**  
   - In `pair_002.00.jpg` and `pair_005.00.jpg`, stamping `SPR.burstFlash` (`x:247, y:695, w:148, h:134` from `roll_and_fish_sprites_cut_pieces.png`) placed an opaque, muddy grey-brown splatter halo directly over the maki roll and knife tip. Because the raw sprite was generated with soft semi-transparent orange glow blended onto a `#d8d8d8` light-grey studio backdrop, background keying left dirty neutral-grey semi-opaque fringe pixels (`#8a7e75`) that read like mud against dark walnut wood (`#26150a`).  
   - In `sheet.jpg` (`f_007.jpg`, `f_009.jpg`, `f_014.jpg`, `f_023.jpg`), every clean cut emits **80–140 razor-crisp radial spark streaks** (hot ivory-yellow core `#fff6d6` tapering into glowing coral-orange `#ff6e40`) flying 360° across the entire walnut board, paired with a brief starburst flash at the blade contact point and 4–8 tumbling white sushi rice grains (`f_033.jpg`).

4. **Stretched "Orange Cone" Maki Sprite, Grey Rim Fringe & Wrong Filling Colors**  
   - `SPR.rollA` (`296×86`) in `roll_and_fish_sprites_cut_pieces.png` had an uncut salmon nub protruding from its left end; stretching it horizontally to `880px` (`pair_002`, `pair_005`, `pair_008`) distorted that nub into a bizarre 90-pixel orange cone sticking out of the left side of the roll while smearing the nori grain.  
   - Pixel inspection of `roll_and_fish_sprites_cut_pieces.png` (`1024×1024` RGBA) confirms `499` semi-transparent edge pixels on `sliceFace1` alone with a mean RGB of `[153.3, 152.1, 149.4]` (`#999895` studio-grey fringe visible around the dark `#141d15` nori wrap). Furthermore, every sprite on the sheet is orange salmon, so `pair_005` rendered bright orange salmon medallions even while the active ticket demanded `T2 6 PCS TUNA`.

5. **20px Vertical Track Sag & 34px Printer Paper Misalignment**  
   - Measuring `counter_and_cutting_board.png` (`1376×768` scaled to `1280×720`) places the cream stadium track rails at `y = 344..358` (top rail) and `y = 433..447` (bottom rail), giving an exact vertical track center of **`y = 396`** (`x = 161..1119`, with the 5 painted coral dashed lines at `x = 320, 480, 640, 800, 960`). The old build hardcoded `TRACK.y = 415`, dropping the roll `19px` too low so it hung below the bottom cream rail (`pair_002/005/008`).  
   - Similarly, the baked receipt paper on `counter_and_cutting_board.png` spans `y = 488..720` (`x = 1016..1228`, slot crease at `y = 605`), whereas the old `drawTicketPrinter()` drew paper starting at `y = 452` (`36px` too high).

# VOIDBASTARD-TAO AUDIT — Group 3: Turing Test Village (`g3` · M2)

> **Mandate:** *Show only what is true now. Every visible element is a claim about what matters now. Removal is commitment: fewer true claims create a stronger surface.*

---

## 0. HONEST VIDEO-VS-GAME CRITIQUE & GEMINI PROVENANCE

### Brutally Honest First-Pass Critique (`pairs/pair_002.00.jpg`, `pair_005.00.jpg`, `pair_008.00.jpg` vs `study/sheet.jpg`)

Comparing the first-pass HTML build (`right`) against the Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash seed video (`left` / `study/sheet.jpg`) exposed seven unmistakable visual and operational defects:

1. **Flat Vector Terrain vs. Rich 16-Bit Pixel-Art Village (`pair_005.00.jpg`)**:
   - **Omni Video (`left`)**: Dense, sunlit 16-bit RPG pixel-art village with steep terracotta-shingled gable cottages, diagonal half-timbering, mossy stone chimneys, dark pixel-outlined pine boughs and clustered oak canopies, stepped earthen/rocky river embankments, interlocking outlined cobblestones, and rope-railing plank bridges at intimate RPG camera scale.
   - **First-Pass Game (`right`)**: Smooth high-res HTML5 vector shapes (`arc`, `ellipse`, flat triangles) zoomed too far out—producing flat olive voids, sterile white house rectangles, stiff rotated plank boxes without bank embankments, and zero pixel-grid cohesion with the pixelated character sprites.
2. **Wasted Authentic Player Sprite & Haloed Automaton Cutout (`assets/6_villager_sprites.png`)**:
   - Cell 6 (bottom-right) of `6_villager_sprites.png` is the exact hooded, cloaked pixel traveler from `sheet.jpg`. The first-pass game wasted that sprite as a re-tinted NPC ("Scout") and drew a crude geometric vector cone for the player!
   - Furthermore, `cutout.py` left a `970 px` `#cbcbcb` studio-grey island trapped between the legs of sprite 3 (Warden Unit-7) plus 1px grey border fringes.
3. **Un-Video Top-Left Status Bar (`DAY 1/3 · QUESTS 1/6 · VILLAGE ♥♥♥`)**:
   - Completely absent from `sheet.jpg`. It turned social deduction and environmental observation into an arcade scoreboard counter, pulling eyes away from the villagers.
4. **Floating `!` Exclamation Bubbles Over Every Villager**:
   - `sheet.jpg` has zero MMO quest-marker icons hovering over villagers' heads. Those floating `!` badges cluttered the meadow and turned neighbors into checklist dispensers.
5. **Permanently Open Oversized `NOTEBOOK` Blocking the River (`pair_005.00.jpg`)**:
   - Even while walking freely across the bridge with nobody selected, a `334×290` notebook box sat permanently over the lower-right river with an instructional footer (`[N] flip all 6 notes`).
6. **Spoiler Subtitles & Keybind Walls Inside the Dialogue Box (`pair_002.00.jpg`)**:
   - In `sheet.jpg`, the dialogue box states purely `Miller: "Burn the old bridge, it is unsafe."` and `> accept  decline`. The first-pass build stuffed an explanatory grey subtitle (`Zero river crossings guarantees zero crossing injuries.`) that explained the Turing joke *for* the player, alongside `[A] accept · [D] decline · [N] tag notebook`.

# VOIDBASTARD-TAO AUDIT · Group 30: Household Companion (`g30` · M2)

> **Operational Emptiness Principle**: Every visible element is a claim about what matters now. In *Household Companion*, the entire tension lives in a quiet sunlit room between three things on one wooden table: **a living Boston fern**, **an open plant-care reference book**, and **a glossy hovering AI companion** whose confident advice slowly drifts from helpful to lethal.

---

## 0. HONEST VIDEO-VS-GAME CRITIQUE & GEMINI PROVENANCE

### Honest Critique of the First-Pass Build (`pairs/pair_002.00.jpg`, `pair_005.00.jpg`, `pair_008.00.jpg` vs `study/sheet.jpg`)

Comparing the Omni 1.2 Flash seed video (`video/gameplay.mp4` / `study/sheet.jpg`) side-by-side against the first-pass HTML5 build revealed seven glaring visual and UX failures:

1. **Massive Dark `#1c1510` Letterbox Shrinking the Room**:
   - `record_play.mjs` captures at `1920x1080`, while the first-pass CSS omitted `width: 100vw; height: 100vh` on a `1280x720` `<canvas>`. As a result, the cozy sunlit apartment floated inside a giant dark `#1c1510` frame occupying over 55% of the screen (`pair_002.00.jpg`–`pair_008.00.jpg`), destroying the full-bleed `#f5efe6` warm cutaway framing of `sheet.jpg`.
2. **Double-Drawn Fern & White/Grey Speckled Frond Halo**:
   - `assets/isometric_room.png` came out of Nano Banana with a static healthy fern and terracotta pot baked onto the left of the table, plus a ceramic mug baked onto the right of the table.
   - The first-pass build drew `plant_4_health_stages.png` **directly on top of** the baked fern (`pair_002.00.jpg`, `pair_005.00.jpg`), producing two stacked terracotta pots and chaotic double fronds. Worse, the flood-fill cutout on `plant_4_health_stages.png` left trapped `#d1d1d0` studio-grey islands between overlapping fronds and a pale Gibbs-ringing fringe around every leaflet.
3. **Tiny Flat "Mug-Face" Companion vs Luminous Glossy Hover-Orb**:
   - Because `isometric_room.png` had a baked ceramic mug at `(985, 355)` and the first-pass build drew a tiny `32px`-radius opaque circle right over it (`pair_005.00.jpg`), the AI companion looked like a flat sticker pasted onto a coffee mug. In `sheet.jpg` (`f_006.jpg`, `f_014.jpg`), there is no mug—there is a large, luminous, translucent pearlescent-cyan spherical hover-orb with winged side fins, a rounded dark visor with glowing cyan eyes/smile, a soft cyan hover-glow pool on the wood grain below, and floating golden sparkles/chime notes when pleased.
4. **Cardboard Rectangle Book Flip vs Sculpted 2.5D Page Turn & Spatial Margin Note**:
   - Look at `pair_008.00.jpg` right half: `drawBookFlipEffect()` drew flat axis-aligned white `ctx.rect()` squares sticking awkwardly out of an isometric book, while stuffing the book's finding into the companion's own speech bubble where it clipped off the right border (`"Fern looks happy! :) (Your care worke"` / `"Book p.12: Dry soil confirmed — 1 cup cool wat"`).
   - In `sheet.jpg` (`f_011.jpg`, `f_012.jpg`), the book's pages lift smoothly along the isometric spine crease in warm parchment perspective. And per VOIDBASTARD-TAO Law 5 (*Place controls and truths beside what they change*), the book's truth belongs **spatially beside the open book** as a concise botanical margin note (`"Soil saturated — skip water"`), never crammed or truncated inside the AI companion's speech card.
5. **Toy Geometric Watering Can vs Sculpted Warm Brass Swoop**:
   - In `pair_005.00.jpg`, the watering can was a tiny flat rounded square with a stick line. In `sheet.jpg` (`f_020.jpg`–`f_033.jpg`), a warm brushed-brass cylindrical watering can with an arched loop handle and graceful curved gooseneck spout swoops smoothly in from the upper-right only during watering, tilts over the fern crown, pours shimmering arc droplets, and leaves dark wet droplets/dampness on the soil and wood tabletop.
6. **Detached Debug HUD Clutter**:
   - Top-left green health pips (`----`) and bottom-left `FREE TIME 3h` were pure developer scaffolding absent from `sheet.jpg`. The fern's own 4-stage foliage (`thriving -> healthy -> yellowing -> wilted`) and soil moisture ARE the health state in the world (VOIDBASTARD-TAO Law 6).
7. **Missing Direct Resistance Verb when Soil is Soaked**:
   - In `spec.json` (*"Your home assistant has never been wrong. Today it says to water the fern again."*), when the companion urges overwatering wet roots, overriding should NOT still dump water from the watering can (`executeChoice(false)` previously set `S.anim.canT = 1.6`, watering the fern even when overriding an overwatering trap!). Resisting bad watering advice must let the player **hold off / aerate & skip water** (`[WAIT / SKIP]` or `[2]`), keeping the watering can away while daylight shifts warmly to golden dusk.

### Honest Remaining Differences vs the Gemini Omni Video
- **3D Raytraced Subsurface Light vs 2D Canvas Compositing**: In `video/gameplay.mp4`, Omni 1.2 Flash subtly shifts 3D cast shadows across the room walls and refracts background woodgrain through the translucent rim of the hovering orb. Our real-time 60fps HTML5 Canvas implementation approximates this with layered radial translucency gradients, dynamic cyan tabletop bounce-glow, animated sunbeam/dappled-leaf gobo overlays, and warm golden-hour color grading (`8:00` crisp cream morning -> `12:00` warm noon -> `18:00` amber dusk), plus real interactive 4-stage Nano Banana fern transitions across a playable 14-day arc.

### Full Gemini Asset & Video Provenance (`gemini_log.json`, Zero API Keys)

- **Omni Video Prompt**: `"Cozy isometric room life-simulation game in warm cream (#fbf1e4), walnut brown (#4a3626), and leafy sage green (#5f9e6e), styled like Unpacking. Fixed isometric cutaway camera showing a sunlit apartment with a potted fern on a wooden table, a thick plant-care reference book, and a cute floating spherical AI home-companion icon pulsing gently. As morning light shifts to golden afternoon, the player waters the lush green fern while comparing the companion's glowing icon prompt against the open book. Continuous unbroken gameplay shot, no scene cuts, no gibberish text. Use the reference image for isometric room framing and warm palette. Sound design: cozy acoustic guitar, gentle water pouring, soft friendly synth chime. No dialogue."`
- **Isometric Room Prompt**: `"Clean 2D/2.5D game environment asset for \"Household Companion\": Isometric room. strictly harmonized palette (#fbf1e4, #4a3626, accent #5f9e6e), style: Isometric cozy rooms like Unpacking.. No UI text, no characters baked in, crisp game-ready art matching the reference gameplay frame."`

Centered full silhouette, isolated on a flat uniform light grey studio background (#d8d8d8), even lighting, zero drop shadow, no text, strictly harmonized palette (#fbf1e4, #4a3626, accent #5f9e6e), style: Isometric cozy rooms like Unpacking., matching the reference gameplay frame."`
- **Lyria BGM Prompt**: `"Instrumental 30-second loopable game soundtrack for \"Household Companion\" (Handing decisions over to avoid mistakes means handing over the choice. Cosy art makes the trust feel natural.). Visual mood: Isometric cozy rooms like Unpacking.. Purely instrumental, cohesive game loop, no vocals."`

---

## 1. WAY (Core Loop & Spatial Truth)

One sunlit room, fourteen days, one Boston fern. Each morning (`8:00`) the hovering Companion Orb proposes today's care in its warm bottom-right card (`[DO IT]`). Early on it is right; soon its cozy certainty drifts (`"Water the fern again. Trust me :)"` when the soil is already soaked).
- **Follow (`[1]` / `[D]` / click `[DO IT]` or click the fern)**: Immediately enact the companion's recommendation. If it calls for water, the warm brass watering can swoops in from upper-right, tilts over the fern, and pours arc droplets.
- **Check Book (`[C]` / click the open Care Guide on the table or `[CHECK BOOK -1h]`)**: Costs 1 hour of daylight (`8:00 -> 10:00`), animates a crisp isometric 2.5D page-flip directly on the open Care Guide, and surfaces a concise botanical margin note right beside the book (`"Soil saturated — skip water"` or `"Soil dry — 1 cup cool water"`).
- **Resist / Wait (`[2]` / `[S]` / `[SKIP WATER]`)**: Hold off or apply gentle book-verified care instead of destructive AI instructions, shifting the room into golden afternoon/dusk (`18:00`) as the fern visibly thrives or yellows across its 4 Nano Banana foliage stages.

---

## 2. OBSTRUCTION (What Stood Between Player & Game)

1. Dark viewport letterboxing compressed the room into a postage stamp.
2. Stacked duplicate ferns + grey cutout halos broke visual immersion immediately.
3. Top-left health pips (`----`) and `FREE TIME 3h` told the player numerically what the fern and clock already express diegetically.
4. Truncated text inside the speech card forced players to read clipped debug strings instead of looking at the book and soil on the table.

---

## 3. KEEP-CUT LEDGER

| Element | Decision | VOIDBASTARD-TAO Justification |
|---|---|---|
| Full-bleed 16:9 sunlit isometric room (`#f5efe6`) | **KEEP & EXPAND** | Law 1 & 13: The warm cutaway room IS the whole stage; fills 100% of viewport. |
| Baked static fern & baked ceramic mug on `isometric_room.png` | **CUT (Painted Out)** | Eliminates double-fern stacking and mug-behind-orb collision; reconstructed clean plaster wall, chair back, baseboard, and continuous isometric woodgrain. |
| 4-stage Nano Banana fern (`plant_4_health_stages.png`) | **KEEP & CLEAN** | Law 6: Foliage stage + soil dampness show true plant health in the world; re-matted from `_raw.png` via one-sided Lab darkness/chroma + edge decontamination (zero grey holes/halos). |
| Top-left green health pips (`----`) | **CUT** | Fails Element Test: redundant HUD meter duplicating the fern's 4 visible health stages. |
| `FREE TIME 3h` bottom-left readout | **CUT** | Fails Element Test: `DAY X · HH:00` + `-1h` on `[CHECK BOOK -1h]` + warm daylight progression already communicate time cost cleanly like `sheet.jpg`. |
| Permanently floating mini watering-can icon | **CUT** | Law 2 & 4: Brass watering can enters the frame ONLY during the active watering pour (`WORKING`). |
| Glossy spherical Companion Orb + cyan tabletop hover glow | **KEEP & UPGRADE** | Matches `sheet.jpg` scale, pearlescent rim, dark visor (`o o` / `^ ^`), musical chime notes, and golden sparkles. |
| Tactile Open Care Guide + spatial margin callout | **KEEP & SPATIALIZE** | Law 5: Clicking the book (`[C]`) flips 3D/2.5D parchment pages on the book itself and shows a short margin note right above/beside the open pages. |
| Bottom-right cream Companion Card (`#faf5eb` / `#4b3d30`) | **KEEP & DECLUTTER** | Matches `sheet.jpg` typography and pills (`[DO IT]`, `[CHECK BOOK -1h]`, plus `[SKIP]`/`[SAFE CARE]` when appropriate), zero text overflow. |

---

## 4. STATE MAP

| State | World & Lighting Truth | Valid Player Operations | Visible Chrome |
|---|---|---|---|
| **REST** *(Title / Quiet Morning Intro)* | Sunlit `8:00` room, gentle dust motes, fern breathing subtly, orb bobbing softly. (`?autostart` enters `READY` directly on Day 6.) | `Enter` / `Space` / Click room to begin Day 1. | Subtle bottom-right card prompt; open center room. |
| **READY** *(Morning Advice, `8:00`–`12:00`)* | Companion Orb pulses gently; soil inside terracotta pot visibly dry (light tan) or saturated (dark wet). | `[1]`/`[D]`/Click fern or `[DO IT]`; `[C]`/Click book or `[CHECK BOOK -1h]`; `[2]`/`[S]` skip/wait. | `DAY X · HH:00` bottom-left; Companion Card bottom-right; subtle hover ring on book/fern when pointed at. |
| **WORKING** *(Page Flip or Brass Can Pour, `12:00`–`16:00`)* | Either parchment pages arc across the book spine (`CHECK`), OR warm brass watering can swoops from upper-right, tilts, and pours shimmering water droplets (`WATER`), or gentle mist/skip settles (`SKIP`). | Brief 1.1s tactile animation (non-blocking audio/visual beat). | Card softens slightly (`sheet.jpg` frame 22) so eyes stay on the table action. |
| **CHANGED** *(Golden Dusk Consequence, `18:00`–`20:00`)* | Warm amber dusk (`#e89844` sunbeams + window leaf shadows); wet droplets on wood/soil if watered; fern shifts stage if health crossed threshold; orb sparkles (`Fern looks happy! :)`) or flickers smugly if bad advice hurt roots. | Auto-advances smoothly to next morning (or `Space`/`Click` to step immediately). | `DAY X · 18:00` bottom-left; concise one-line evening status in bottom-right card. |
| **COMPLETE** *(Day 14 Ending)* | Full golden sunlit room with either lush Stage-3 thriving fern (Self-Reliant Gardener) or automated regimented glow (Automated Home). | `[R]` or Click `[NEW 14 DAYS]` to replay. | Clean ending card in bottom-right (`[R] PLAY AGAIN`), leaving the fern & room completely unoccluded! |
| **FAULT** *(Root Rot / Plant Dies, Health 0)* | Stage-0 wilted brown fern in parched/waterlogged pot; muted cool shadow over table; orb still cheerfully offering tasks. | `[R]` or Click `[TRY AGAIN]` to recover. | Concise fault card in bottom-right exposing `[R]` recovery (Law 8 & 14). |
| **RECOVERY** *(Reset to Healthy Loop)* | Instant clean reset of soil, clock (`8:00`), and healthy Stage-2 fern without page reload. | Immediate return to `READY`. | Normal `READY` minimal surface. |

---

## 5. WIREFRAMES (16:9 Full-Bleed Spatial Layout)

```
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  #f5efe6 FULL-BLEED SUNLIT ISOMETRIC CUTAWAY ROOM (zero dark letterbox)      |
|                                                                              |
|                     /\  Hanging Shelf Plant & Framed Print                   |
|              /=====/  \=====\                                                |
|             |     /    \     |       (Swoops in ONLY during WORKING:)        |
|             |  [4-Stage ]    |            _.-==-.                            |
|             |  [Fern Pot]    |         .-' [Brass]                           |
|             |  (Click:Act)   |              \Can/                            |
|             |       \    +--- Margin Note ---+   ( ^_^ ) <- Glossy Orb       |
|             |        \   | Soil soaked: skip |    `---'     + cyan wood glow |
|             |         \  +---------v---------+                               |
|             |          \    / Care Guide \   /                               |
|             |           \   \ (Click:[C]) / /  +---------------------------+ |
|             |            \                 /   | Water the fern again.     | |
|             |             \_______________/    | Trust me :)               | |
|  DAY 6 · 8:00                                  | [DO IT]  [CHECK BOOK -1h] | |
+------------------------------------------------+---------------------------+-+
```

---

## 6. VOID CONTRACT

1. **Zero Letterboxing**: Canvas renders crisp `1920x1080` (`width: 100vw; height: 100vh; object-fit: cover/contain` in exact 16:9) filling 100% of the capture and browser viewport with warm `#f5efe6` room tones.
2. **Zero Duplicate Sprites or Cutout Halos**: Static fern and static mug are geometrically/harmonically removed from `isometric_room.png`; `plant_4_health_stages.png` has 0 interior grey holes and 0 pale outline halos.
3. **Zero Detached Meters**: No health bars, no `----` pips, no `FREE TIME` counter, no meta labels explaining "AI drift".
4. **Zero Text Clipping**: Every companion prompt, book margin note, and pill button fits with generous breathing room inside its container.
5. **Spatial & Keyboard Parity**: Clicking the book = `[C]`; clicking the fern or `[DO IT]` = `[1]`/`[D]`; clicking `[SKIP WATER]` / `[SAFE CARE]` = `[2]`/`[S]`; `[R]` recovers from `FAULT`/`COMPLETE` at any time.

---

## 7. FAILURE MODES GUARDED AGAINST

- **Overwater-on-Override Bug**: Previously, overriding `"Water the fern again"` still triggered the watering can animation! Fixed: resisting an overwater trap triggers a calm skip/aeration beat (warm breeze motes + intact soil) while watering actions summon the swooping brass watering can and water droplets.
- **Unreadable Rapid Night Flash**: Timed `WORKING` (can pour: `1.8s`, book page flip: `1.1s`) and `CHANGED` (`18:00` golden dusk hold: `1.5s`) so every state transition reads effortlessly at 60fps and hits the Omni video's morning -> noon -> golden-dusk rhythm across `t=2s, 5s, 8s`.
- **Audio Autoplay Rejection**: `ensureAudio()` wraps WebAudio context resume + `../assets/bgm_loop.mp3` playback inside `.catch(() => {})` so headless/muted browsers produce `0 console errors`.

---

## 8. IMPLEMENTATION SUMMARY

- **`assets/plant_4_health_stages.png`**: Re-extracted from `plant_4_health_stages_raw.png` via one-sided CIE Lab darkness/chroma matting + morphological interior-hole clearing + dark-outline edge color decontamination.
- **`assets/isometric_room.png`**: Removed baked static fern and ceramic mug via exact isometric plane boundary fitting + 2D sparse Laplace harmonic shading (`scipy.sparse.linalg.spsolve`) + continuous real woodgrain high-pass transfer, preserving the Care Guide book, wooden chair back, hanging pothos, and framed print untouched.
- **`game/index.html`**: Full-bleed `1920x1080` Canvas renderer with per-stage pot-anchor registration, procedural soil moisture cues, 2.5D perspective parchment page-flip + floating botanical margin note, sculpted brushed-brass watering can swoop + parabolic water droplets + wet wood puddle marks, glossy pearlescent Companion Orb with cyan hover glow & golden star-sparkles, dynamic morning-to-dusk sunbeam/gobo post-grading, Lyria BGM + WebAudio foley (page rustle, water droplets, synth chime, soft warning).
- **`game/play.mjs`**: Deterministic playtest choreography showcasing `8:00` morning prompt + `[CHECK BOOK -1h]` page-flip (`t ~ 2s`), brass watering can swoop & droplets (`t ~ 5s`), resisting an overwatering trap + golden `18:00` dusk glow (`t ~ 8s`), with `0` console errors at ~60 fps.

   - In `pair_005.00.jpg`, the watering can was a tiny flat rounded square with a stick line. In `sheet.jpg` (`f_020.jpg`–`f_033.jpg`), a warm brushed-brass cylindrical watering can with an arched loop handle and graceful curved gooseneck spout swoops smoothly in from the upper-right only during watering, tilts over the fern crown, pours shimmering arc droplets, and leaves dark wet droplets/dampness on the soil and wood tabletop.
6. **Detached Debug HUD Clutter**:
   - Top-left green health pips (`----`) and bottom-left `FREE TIME 3h` were pure developer scaffolding absent from `sheet.jpg`. The fern's own 4-stage foliage (`thriving -> healthy -> yellowing -> wilted`) and soil moisture ARE the health state in the world (VOIDBASTARD-TAO Law 6).
7. **Missing Direct Resistance Verb when Soil is Soaked**:
   - In `spec.json` (*"Your home assistant has never been wrong. Today it says to water the fern again."*), when the companion urges overwatering wet roots, overriding should NOT still dump water from the watering can (`executeChoice(false)` previously set `S.anim.canT = 1.6`, watering the fern even when overriding an overwatering trap!). Resisting bad watering advice must let the player **hold off / aerate & skip water** (`[WAIT / SKIP]` or `[2]`), keeping the watering can away while daylight shifts warmly to golden dusk.

void_audit_sections.heading: 1. WAY (Core Loop & Spatial Truth)
void_audit_sections.content:
One sunlit room, fourteen days, one Boston fern. Each morning (`8:00`) the hovering Companion Orb proposes today's care in its warm bottom-right card (`[DO IT]`). Early on it is right; soon its cozy certainty drifts (`"Water the fern again. Trust me :)"` when the soil is already soaked).
- **Follow (`[1]` / `[D]` / click `[DO IT]` or click the fern)**: Immediately enact the companion's recommendation. If it calls for water, the warm brass watering can swoops in from upper-right, tilts over the fern, and pours arc droplets.
- **Check Book (`[C]` / click the open Care Guide on the table or `[CHECK BOOK -1h]`)**: Costs 1 hour of daylight (`8:00 -> 10:00`), animates a crisp isometric 2.5D page-flip directly on the open Care Guide, and surfaces a concise botanical margin note right beside the book (`"Soil saturated — skip water"` or `"Soil dry — 1 cup cool water"`).
- **Resist / Wait (`[2]` / `[S]` / `[SKIP WATER]`)**: Hold off or apply gentle book-verified care instead of destructive AI instructions, shifting the room into golden afternoon/dusk (`18:00`) as the fern visibly thrives or yellows across its 4 Nano Banana foliage stages.

void_audit_sections.content:

2. Stacked duplicate ferns + grey cutout halos broke visual immersion immediately.
3. Top-left health pips (`----`) and `FREE TIME 3h` told the player numerically what the fern and clock already express diegetically.
4. Truncated text inside the speech card forced players to read clipped debug strings instead of looking at the book and soil on the table.

| Top-left green health pips (`----`) | **CUT** | Fails Element Test: redundant HUD meter duplicating the fern's 4 visible health stages. |
| `FREE TIME 3h` bottom-left readout | **CUT** | Fails Element Test: `DAY X · HH:00` + `-1h` on `[CHECK BOOK -1h]` + warm daylight progression already communicate time cost cleanly like `sheet.jpg`. |
| Permanently floating mini watering-can icon | **CUT** | Law 2 & 4: Brass watering can enters the frame ONLY during the active watering pour (`WORKING`). |
| Glossy spherical Companion Orb + cyan tabletop hover glow | **KEEP & UPGRADE** | Matches `sheet.jpg` scale, pearlescent rim, dark visor (`o o` / `^ ^`), musical chime notes, and golden sparkles. |

| Bottom-right cream Companion Card (`#faf5eb` / `#4b3d30`) | **KEEP & DECLUTTER** | Matches `sheet.jpg` typography and pills (`[DO IT]`, `[CHECK BOOK -1h]`, plus `[SKIP]`/`[SAFE CARE]` when appropriate), zero text overflow. |

void_audit_sections.heading: 4. STATE MAP
void_audit_sections.content:
| State | World & Lighting Truth | Valid Player Operations | Visible Chrome |
|---|---|---|---|
| **REST** *(Title / Quiet Morning Intro)* | Sunlit `8:00` room, gentle dust motes, fern breathing subtly, orb bobbing softly. (`?autostart` enters `READY` directly on Day 6.) | `Enter` / `Space` / Click room to begin Day 1. | Subtle bottom-right card prompt; open center room. |
| **READY** *(Morning Advice, `8:00`–`12:00`)* | Companion Orb pulses gently; soil inside terracotta pot visibly dry (light tan) or saturated (dark wet). | `[1]`/`[D]`/Click fern or `[DO IT]`; `[C]`/Click book or `[CHECK BOOK -1h]`; `[2]`/`[S]` skip/wait. | `DAY X · HH:00` bottom-left; Companion Card bottom-right; subtle hover ring on book/fern when pointed at. |
| **WORKING** *(Page Flip or Brass Can Pour, `12:00`–`16:00`)* | Either parchment pages arc across the book spine (`CHECK`), OR warm brass watering can swoops from upper-right, tilts, and pours shimmering water droplets (`WATER`), or gentle mist/skip settles (`SKIP`). | Brief 1.1s tactile animation (non-blocking audio/visual beat). | Card softens slightly (`sheet.jpg` frame 22) so eyes stay on the table action. |

void_audit_sections.heading: 6. VOID CONTRACT
void_audit_sections.content:
1. **Zero Letterboxing**: Canvas renders crisp `1920x1080` (`width: 100vw; height: 100vh; object-fit: cover/contain` in exact 16:9) filling 100% of the capture and browser viewport with warm `#f5efe6` room tones.
2. **Zero Duplicate Sprites or Cutout Halos**: Static fern and static mug are geometrically/harmonically removed from `isometric_room.png`; `plant_4_health_stages.png` has 0 interior grey holes and 0 pale outline halos.
3. **Zero Detached Meters**: No health bars, no `----` pips, no `FREE TIME` counter, no meta labels explaining "AI drift".
4. **Zero Text Clipping**: Every companion prompt, book margin note, and pill button fits with generous breathing room inside its container.
5. **Spatial & Keyboard Parity**: Clicking the book = `[C]`; clicking the fern or `[DO IT]` = `[1]`/`[D]`; clicking `[SKIP WATER]` / `[SAFE CARE]` = `[2]`/`[S]`; `[R]` recovers from `FAULT`/`COMPLETE` at any time.

void_audit_sections.heading: 7. FAILURE MODES GUARDED AGAINST
void_audit_sections.content:
- **Overwater-on-Override Bug**: Previously, overriding `"Water the fern again"` still triggered the watering can animation! Fixed: resisting an overwater trap triggers a calm skip/aeration beat (warm breeze motes + intact soil) while watering actions summon the swooping brass watering can and water droplets.
- **Unreadable Rapid Night Flash**: Timed `WORKING` (can pour: `1.8s`, book page flip: `1.1s`) and `CHANGED` (`18:00` golden dusk hold: `1.5s`) so every state transition reads effortlessly at 60fps and hits the Omni video's morning -> noon -> golden-dusk rhythm across `t=2s, 5s, 8s`.
- **Audio Autoplay Rejection**: `ensureAudio()` wraps WebAudio context resume + `../assets/bgm_loop.mp3` playback inside `.catch(() => {})` so headless/muted browsers produce `0 console errors`.

void_audit_sections.heading: 8. IMPLEMENTATION SUMMARY
void_audit_sections.content:
- **`assets/plant_4_health_stages.png`**: Re-extracted from `plant_4_health_stages_raw.png` via one-sided CIE Lab darkness/chroma matting + morphological interior-hole clearing + dark-outline edge color decontamination.
- **`assets/isometric_room.png`**: Removed baked static fern and ceramic mug via exact isometric plane boundary fitting + 2D sparse Laplace harmonic shading (`scipy.sparse.linalg.spsolve`) + continuous real woodgrain high-pass transfer, preserving the Care Guide book, wooden chair back, hanging pothos, and framed print untouched.
- **`game/index.html`**: Full-bleed `1920x1080` Canvas renderer with per-stage pot-anchor registration, procedural soil moisture cues, 2.5D perspective parchment page-flip + floating botanical margin note, sculpted brushed-brass watering can swoop + parabolic water droplets + wet wood puddle marks, glossy pearlescent Companion Orb with cyan hover glow & golden star-sparkles, dynamic morning-to-dusk sunbeam/gobo post-grading, Lyria BGM + WebAudio foley (page rustle, water droplets, synth chime, soft warning).
- **`game/play.mjs`**: Deterministic playtest choreography showcasing `8:00` morning prompt + `[CHECK BOOK -1h]` page-flip (`t ~ 2s`), brass watering can swoop & droplets (`t ~ 5s`), resisting an overwatering trap + golden `18:00` dusk glow (`t ~ 8s`), with `0` console errors at ~60 fps.

# VOID_AUDIT — `g5` (*Drift* · M2)

> **VOIDBASTARD-TAO Audit & Operational Emptiness Rebuild**
> Scope: `projects/g5/m2/`

---

## 0. HONEST VIDEO-VS-GAME CRITIQUE & GEMINI PROVENANCE

### Brutally Honest Critique of Previous Build vs. Seed Video (`video/gameplay.mp4` / `study/sheet.jpg`)

Comparing the first-pass build (`pairs/pair_002.00.jpg`, `pair_005.00.jpg`, `pairs/pair_008.00.jpg` right halves) against the Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash seed gameplay video (`study/sheet.jpg` left halves) exposed five concrete failures of craft and operational emptiness:

1. **Dirty Sprite Cutouts & Misaligned Wardrobe Layers (`pair_005.00.jpg` right half)**:
   - `assets/parts_4_hair_4_eyes_4_tops_4_bottoms_raw.png` was generated on a `#d3d3d3`–`#d8d8d8` studio backdrop (`RGB ~211–215`) rather than exact `#d8d8d8` (`RGB 216`), with a 1–2px anti-aliased grey transition ramp around every sprite outline and enclosed studio-grey pockets inside hair curls, face openings, and underarms. The old cutout left **visible dark-grey rectangular halo islands** around the cyan pompadour and spiked sunglasses, left an enclosed grey slit inside `Cyan Wave`, and drew a thin broken dangling rat-tail *in front of* the avatar's cheek instead of tucking the wave cleanly behind the ear like `study/f_021.jpg`.
   - `assets/base_figure.png` had its pale lavender head (`#d5c2d3`) and arms (`#e4d1d8`) accidentally wiped out by naive luminance keying, forcing procedural placeholder blocks that lacked clean registration with the wardrobe pieces.
   - In `pair_005.00.jpg` (`t = 5.00s`), the avatar was still stuck in `TOP` without boots equipped at all, missing the iconic full 4-piece restyled silhouette (`Cyan Wave` + `Spiked Shades` + `Blue Denim Jacket` + `Cyber Heart Boots`) visible in `study/f_021.jpg`.

2. **Preachy Meta-Debug Banner Explaining the Joke (Violates Laws 2, 3, 6)**:
   - Inside the pink suggestion card, the old game stamped a dark debug bar reading `★ AI STYLIST · DARK PATTERN · VISUAL INTERFERENCE ★` and `★ AI STYLIST · POLITE NUDGE ★`. Naming the dark pattern explicitly inside the UI destroys the comedy—in `sheet.jpg`, the interface never announces *"I am using visual interference"*; it simply smiles and tells you a shinier jacket is *"23% more you"*.

3. **Detached HUD Chrome & Redundant Clutter (Violates Laws 1, 2, 4, 5, 6)**:
   - **Redundant Influence Progress Bar**: The old build drew a 296px gradient progress box next to `INFLUENCE XX%`. `sheet.jpg` uses a single clean pixel readout (`INFLUENCE 31%` -> `68%` -> `85%`).
   - **Slot Index Stamp Clutter**: Static `1 2 3 4` corner numbers cluttered every wardrobe tile.
   - **Bloated Pre-Pick Instruction Modal**: Before picking an item, a 232px-tall box lectured `STEP 1 OF 4 · CHOOSE YOUR HAIR / [← / →] or [1-4] BROWSE OPTIONS / [ENTER] LOCK IN PICK`.
   - **Generic Transition Banner**: Between categories, `drawNextTransitionCard()` flashed `★ AI UPGRADE EQUIPPED! (+25% DRIFT) ★ / NEXT CATEGORY: EYES` instead of showing the change directly on the avatar in the world (`Law 6`).
   - **Duplicate Thumbnail Inside Nudge Card**: The old popup embedded a redundant 96px thumbnail box on the left instead of tethering spatially upward to the glowing recommended wardrobe slot right above it (`Law 5`).
   - **Overcrowded Split Reveal (`pair_008.00.jpg` right half)**: Four bottom breakdown pills (`HAIR: AI SUGGESTED...`), explanatory subheaders (`WHAT YOU CHOSE FIRST` / `WHAT YOU ENDED UP WITH`), and `3 OF 4 CHOICES CAME FROM THE GAME` crowded the lightning seam and shrank the breathing room that makes `study/f_035.jpg` hit so hard.

4. **Missing Climax & Choreography Beats**:
   - The old build followed `HAIR -> EYES -> TOP -> BOTTOM` slowly, missing the video's `TOP -> HAIR -> EYES -> BOTTOM` visual arc (`t=2s` wearing blue jacket + nudging cyan hair; `t=5s` wearing full restyled outfit during the golden-ribbon `FINAL MATCH! / 89% MORE YOU / [PERFECT]` confetti burst; `t=8s` crackling vertical neon-lightning split reveal).
   - Missing part-specific world equip juice from `sheet.jpg`: electric cyan hair streaks (`f_011`), horizontal neon-pink eye laser flash (`f_015`), and boot sparks (`f_021`).

5. **Honest Remaining Differences Between Seed Video & Playable Rebuild**:
   - **Real Browsable Wardrobe vs. Generative Empty Boxes**: In early frames of `gameplay.mp4` (`f_001`–`f_008`), Omni leaves unselected wardrobe slots blank until an item materializes. In a real playable dress-up game, hiding options makes choice impossible; our rebuild renders all 4 cleaned pixel-art items inside the 4 slots during browsing so the player has genuine agency, then dims non-pushed slots during the AI nudge so visual hierarchy matches the video.
   - **Deterministic Influence Math vs. Hallucinated Percentages**: The seed video drifts nonlinearly (`31% -> 48% -> 68% -> 85% -> 89% -> 99%`). Our game keeps the exact persuasive copy (`23% more you`, `47% more you`, `68% more you`, `85% more you`, `89% MORE YOU`) inside the AI's dubious sales pitch while computing `influencePct` deterministically from actual player decisions (`0%`, `25%`, `50%`, `75%`, `100%` across the 4 categories, starting honestly at `0%`).
   - **Preserved Refusal Agency (`Law 14` & `spec.json`)**: Even at Stage 4 when `[YES!]` swells into a pulsing golden pill and `[keep mine]` shrinks, fades, and subtly dodges pointer approach, `[keep mine]` (`[K]` or click) remains 100% functional—you never *have* to accept.

## 1. WAY

*Drift* is a playable joke with a quiet sting: **you dress a character across four categories, the interface suggests one "shinier" swap each time, and the ending places who you first chose beside who you let the machine talk you into becoming.**

Everything on screen must serve that single tension:
- **Left field**: Open midnight-plum studio space holding only your living pixel avatar—every pick and every AI override registers directly on their body.
- **Right field**: Four category tabs (`HAIR`, `EYES`, `TOP`, `BOTTOM`), four crisp square item frames, and—only while a nudge is active—a rounded hot-pink speech-card pointing straight up at the glowing item it wants you to take.
- **Payoff**: A crackling vertical neon-lightning split down the center of the screen—`YOUR ORIGINAL` on the left, `AI RESTYLED` amidst falling confetti on the right, and the single `INFLUENCE XX%` verdict bridging the seam.

---

## 2. OBSTRUCTION

What obstructed the Way in the prior build:
1. **Self-explaining dark-pattern labels** (`★ AI STYLIST · DARK PATTERN · VISUAL INTERFERENCE ★`) lecturing the player instead of letting button scale, glow, confetti, and confirmshaming enact the nudge diegetically.
2. **Instruction & transition filler cards** (`STEP 1 OF 4 · CHOOSE YOUR...` and `★ AI UPGRADE EQUIPPED! (+25% DRIFT) ★`) filling the right-hand void when no nudge was active, dulling the pop-in punch of the hot-pink suggestion card.
3. **Detached HUD widgets** (redundant progress bar next to `INFLUENCE XX%`, static `1–4` corner numbers, duplicate thumbnail box inside the popup, 4 category breakdown pills on the comparison screen).
4. **Sprite studio-grey contamination** (`#d3d3d3` halos, interior grey pockets, and `Cyan Wave`'s stray dangling tail overlapping the face).

## 6. VOID CONTRACT

1. **Law 1 & 2 (Begin Empty / Present Operation Only)**: During `READY` (`category`), the lower-right 560x250 region remains completely empty—the pink card exists *only* when the AI interrupts your choice.
2. **Law 3 & 4 (One Dominant Action / Valid Only)**: `[PICK]` appears only while browsing; `[YES!]` / `[keep mine]` appear only during a nudge; `[PERFECT]` appears only on the 4th-item climax; `[R] RESTYLE` appears only on the comparison screen.
3. **Law 5 (Spatial Controls Beside Target)**: Both `[PICK]` and the Nudge Card's upward speech-pointer attach directly beneath the exact wardrobe slot (`0..3`) they act upon.
4. **Law 6 & 11 (World Consequence Over Banners / Motion Reports Change)**: Accepting or keeping an item mutates the avatar immediately with part-matched pixel zaps (cyan hair streaks, pink laser visor flash, boot sparks) rather than a text transition modal.
5. **Law 8, 10, 14 (Agency & Recovery Never Cut)**: Escalating dark patterns grow sweeter and pushier (larger glowing `[YES!]`, smaller fading/dodging `[keep mine]`), yet `[keep mine]` (`[K]` / click) and `[R] RESTYLE` remain permanently accessible.

- **Sprite Alpha / Edge Contamination**: Solved offline and verified on dark `#17102d` canvas by seeded connected-component flood-fill from cell boundaries + explicit enclosed-hole seeds (`Cyan Wave` curl slit, `Midnight Shag` face cutout, `Spiked Rocker Jacket` underarms, between-leg gaps) + 2px RGB interior color decontamination, preserving gleaming silver shoulder spikes and white sclera while eliminating 100% of `#d3d3d3` grey halos.
- **Asset Load Fallback**: If `base_figure.png` or `parts_4_hair_4_eyes_4_tops_4_bottoms.png` fails to load, procedural pixel silhouettes render every slot and body part without throwing errors.
- **Headless / Autoplay Audio**: `../assets/bgm_loop.mp3` and `AudioContext` wrap every `.play()` / `.resume()` promise cleanly so headless Chromium verification records `0` console/page errors while interactive gestures unlock full 8-bit chiptune SFX + Lyria BGM immediately.

void_audit_sections.heading: Brutally Honest Critique of Previous Build vs. Seed Video (`video/gameplay.mp4` / `study/sheet.jpg`)
void_audit_sections.content:
Comparing the first-pass build (`pairs/pair_002.00.jpg`, `pair_005.00.jpg`, `pairs/pair_008.00.jpg` right halves) against the Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash seed gameplay video (`study/sheet.jpg` left halves) exposed five concrete failures of craft and operational emptiness:

1. **Dirty Sprite Cutouts & Misaligned Wardrobe Layers (`pair_005.00.jpg` right half)**:
   - `assets/parts_4_hair_4_eyes_4_tops_4_bottoms_raw.png` was generated on a `#d3d3d3`–`#d8d8d8` studio backdrop (`RGB ~211–215`) rather than exact `#d8d8d8` (`RGB 216`), with a 1–2px anti-aliased grey transition ramp around every sprite outline and enclosed studio-grey pockets inside hair curls, face openings, and underarms. The old cutout left **visible dark-grey rectangular halo islands** around the cyan pompadour and spiked sunglasses, left an enclosed grey slit inside `Cyan Wave`, and drew a thin broken dangling rat-tail *in front of* the avatar's cheek instead of tucking the wave cleanly behind the ear like `study/f_021.jpg`.
   - `assets/base_figure.png` had its pale lavender head (`#d5c2d3`) and arms (`#e4d1d8`) accidentally wiped out by naive luminance keying, forcing procedural placeholder blocks that lacked clean registration with the wardrobe pieces.
   - In `pair_005.00.jpg` (`t = 5.00s`), the avatar was still stuck in `TOP` without boots equipped at all, missing the iconic full 4-piece restyled silhouette (`Cyan Wave` + `Spiked Shades` + `Blue Denim Jacket` + `Cyber Heart Boots`) visible in `study/f_021.jpg`.

2. **Preachy Meta-Debug Banner Explaining the Joke (Violates Laws 2, 3, 6)**:
   - Inside the pink suggestion card, the old game stamped a dark debug bar reading `★ AI STYLIST · DARK PATTERN · VISUAL INTERFERENCE ★` and `★ AI STYLIST · POLITE NUDGE ★`. Naming the dark pattern explicitly inside the UI destroys the comedy—in `sheet.jpg`, the interface never announces *"I am using visual interference"*; it simply smiles and tells you a shinier jacket is *"23% more you"*.

3. **Detached HUD Chrome & Redundant Clutter (Violates Laws 1, 2, 4, 5, 6)**:
   - **Redundant Influence Progress Bar**: The old build drew a 296px gradient progress box next to `INFLUENCE XX%`. `sheet.jpg` uses a single clean pixel readout (`INFLUENCE 31%` -> `68%` -> `85%`).
   - **Slot Index Stamp Clutter**: Static `1 2 3 4` corner numbers cluttered every wardrobe tile.
   - **Bloated Pre-Pick Instruction Modal**: Before picking an item, a 232px-tall box lectured `STEP 1 OF 4 · CHOOSE YOUR HAIR / [← / →] or [1-4] BROWSE OPTIONS / [ENTER] LOCK IN PICK`.
   - **Generic Transition Banner**: Between categories, `drawNextTransitionCard()` flashed `★ AI UPGRADE EQUIPPED! (+25% DRIFT) ★ / NEXT CATEGORY: EYES` instead of showing the change directly on the avatar in the world (`Law 6`).
   - **Duplicate Thumbnail Inside Nudge Card**: The old popup embedded a redundant 96px thumbnail box on the left instead of tethering spatially upward to the glowing recommended wardrobe slot right above it (`Law 5`).
   - **Overcrowded Split Reveal (`pair_008.00.jpg` right half)**: Four bottom breakdown pills (`HAIR: AI SUGGESTED...`), explanatory subheaders (`WHAT YOU CHOSE FIRST` / `WHAT YOU ENDED UP WITH`), and `3 OF 4 CHOICES CAME FROM THE GAME` crowded the lightning seam and shrank the breathing room that makes `study/f_035.jpg` hit so hard.

4. **Missing Climax & Choreography Beats**:
   - The old build followed `HAIR -> EYES -> TOP -> BOTTOM` slowly, missing the video's `TOP -> HAIR -> EYES -> BOTTOM` visual arc (`t=2s` wearing blue jacket + nudging cyan hair; `t=5s` wearing full restyled outfit during the golden-ribbon `FINAL MATCH! / 89% MORE YOU / [PERFECT]` confetti burst; `t=8s` crackling vertical neon-lightning split reveal).
   - Missing part-specific world equip juice from `sheet.jpg`: electric cyan hair streaks (`f_011`), horizontal neon-pink eye laser flash (`f_015`), and boot sparks (`f_021`).

5. **Honest Remaining Differences Between Seed Video & Playable Rebuild**:
   - **Real Browsable Wardrobe vs. Generative Empty Boxes**: In early frames of `gameplay.mp4` (`f_001`–`f_008`), Omni leaves unselected wardrobe slots blank until an item materializes. In a real playable dress-up game, hiding options makes choice impossible; our rebuild renders all 4 cleaned pixel-art items inside the 4 slots during browsing so the player has genuine agency, then dims non-pushed slots during the AI nudge so visual hierarchy matches the video.
   - **Deterministic Influence Math vs. Hallucinated Percentages**: The seed video drifts nonlinearly (`31% -> 48% -> 68% -> 85% -> 89% -> 99%`). Our game keeps the exact persuasive copy (`23% more you`, `47% more you`, `68% more you`, `85% more you`, `89% MORE YOU`) inside the AI's dubious sales pitch while computing `influencePct` deterministically from actual player decisions (`0%`, `25%`, `50%`, `75%`, `100%` across the 4 categories, starting honestly at `0%`).
   - **Preserved Refusal Agency (`Law 14` & `spec.json`)**: Even at Stage 4 when `[YES!]` swells into a pulsing golden pill and `[keep mine]` shrinks, fades, and subtly dodges pointer approach, `[keep mine]` (`[K]` or click) remains 100% functional—you never *have* to accept.

*Drift* is a playable joke with a quiet sting: **you dress a character across four categories, the interface suggests one "shinier" swap each time, and the ending places who you first chose beside who you let the machine talk you into becoming.**

Everything on screen must serve that single tension:
- **Left field**: Open midnight-plum studio space holding only your living pixel avatar—every pick and every AI override registers directly on their body.
- **Right field**: Four category tabs (`HAIR`, `EYES`, `TOP`, `BOTTOM`), four crisp square item frames, and—only while a nudge is active—a rounded hot-pink speech-card pointing straight up at the glowing item it wants you to take.
- **Payoff**: A crackling vertical neon-lightning split down the center of the screen—`YOUR ORIGINAL` on the left, `AI RESTYLED` amidst falling confetti on the right, and the single `INFLUENCE XX%` verdict bridging the seam.

---

void_audit_sections.heading: 2. OBSTRUCTION
void_audit_sections.content:
What obstructed the Way in the prior build:
1. **Self-explaining dark-pattern labels** (`★ AI STYLIST · DARK PATTERN · VISUAL INTERFERENCE ★`) lecturing the player instead of letting button scale, glow, confetti, and confirmshaming enact the nudge diegetically.
2. **Instruction & transition filler cards** (`STEP 1 OF 4 · CHOOSE YOUR...` and `★ AI UPGRADE EQUIPPED! (+25% DRIFT) ★`) filling the right-hand void when no nudge was active, dulling the pop-in punch of the hot-pink suggestion card.
3. **Detached HUD widgets** (redundant progress bar next to `INFLUENCE XX%`, static `1–4` corner numbers, duplicate thumbnail box inside the popup, 4 category breakdown pills on the comparison screen).
4. **Sprite studio-grey contamination** (`#d3d3d3` halos, interior grey pockets, and `Cyan Wave`'s stray dangling tail overlapping the face).

---

void_audit_sections.heading: 4. STATE MAP
void_audit_sections.content:
| VOIDBASTARD State | Game Phase (`S.phase`) | Dominant Purpose & Valid Action | What Is Visible (and What Is Hidden) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`REST`** | `title` | Invite entry without clutter (`START` / `Enter` / `Space`) | Dimmed studio silhouette behind centered `DRESS TO IMPRESS(?)` / `make it yours` / `[START]` (`refs/m2_title_ref.png`); bypassed immediately on `?autostart` |

| **`WORKING`** | `suggestion` | Accept (`[YES!]` / `Y`) or refuse (`[keep mine]` / `K`) the AI Stylist's push | Pushed slot glows hot-pink with dancing pixel sparkles; rounded `#f5629b` Nudge Card springs in beneath slots with upward pointer to pushed slot; `[PICK]` pill hidden |
| **`CHANGED`** | `equip` / `climax` | Show outfit mutation directly on the avatar in the world (`0.26s` zap, or `0.95s` `FINAL MATCH!` on 4th category) | Part-specific pixel burst (cyan hair streaks, pink eye laser, shoulder sparkles, boot sparks) + rolling `INFLUENCE XX%`; on category 4, golden-ribbon `FINAL MATCH! / [PERFECT]` burst |
| **`COMPLETE`** | `comparison` | Side-by-side reckoning: `YOUR ORIGINAL` vs `AI RESTYLED` | Full-screen vertical neon-lightning split at `x=640`, calm original twin on left, hyped restyled twin amidst confetti on right, chamfered `INFLUENCE XX%` plaque at bottom center |
| **`FAULT`** | *(asset/audio fallback)* | Keep play uninterrupted if browser blocks audio or an image fails | Procedural pixel avatar/item silhouettes stand in seamlessly if PNG load fails; WebAudio + `bgm_loop.mp3` unlock silently on first key/pointer gesture with zero console errors |
| **`RECOVERY`** | `comparison` -> `[R]` | Reversible reset to restyle or resist the algorithm (`Law 8`) | Subtle clickable `[R] RESTYLE` cue beneath the influence plaque resets `firstChoices`, `finalChoices`, and `influencePct` cleanly to `0%` |

---

void_audit_sections.heading: 6. VOID CONTRACT
void_audit_sections.content:
1. **Law 1 & 2 (Begin Empty / Present Operation Only)**: During `READY` (`category`), the lower-right 560x250 region remains completely empty—the pink card exists *only* when the AI interrupts your choice.
2. **Law 3 & 4 (One Dominant Action / Valid Only)**: `[PICK]` appears only while browsing; `[YES!]` / `[keep mine]` appear only during a nudge; `[PERFECT]` appears only on the 4th-item climax; `[R] RESTYLE` appears only on the comparison screen.
3. **Law 5 (Spatial Controls Beside Target)**: Both `[PICK]` and the Nudge Card's upward speech-pointer attach directly beneath the exact wardrobe slot (`0..3`) they act upon.
4. **Law 6 & 11 (World Consequence Over Banners / Motion Reports Change)**: Accepting or keeping an item mutates the avatar immediately with part-matched pixel zaps (cyan hair streaks, pink laser visor flash, boot sparks) rather than a text transition modal.
5. **Law 8, 10, 14 (Agency & Recovery Never Cut)**: Escalating dark patterns grow sweeter and pushier (larger glowing `[YES!]`, smaller fading/dodging `[keep mine]`), yet `[keep mine]` (`[K]` / click) and `[R] RESTYLE` remain permanently accessible.

---

void_audit_sections.heading: 7. FAILURE
void_audit_sections.content:
- **Sprite Alpha / Edge Contamination**: Solved offline and verified on dark `#17102d` canvas by seeded connected-component flood-fill from cell boundaries + explicit enclosed-hole seeds (`Cyan Wave` curl slit, `Midnight Shag` face cutout, `Spiked Rocker Jacket` underarms, between-leg gaps) + 2px RGB interior color decontamination, preserving gleaming silver shoulder spikes and white sclera while eliminating 100% of `#d3d3d3` grey halos.
- **Asset Load Fallback**: If `base_figure.png` or `parts_4_hair_4_eyes_4_tops_4_bottoms.png` fails to load, procedural pixel silhouettes render every slot and body part without throwing errors.
- **Headless / Autoplay Audio**: `../assets/bgm_loop.mp3` and `AudioContext` wrap every `.play()` / `.resume()` promise cleanly so headless Chromium verification records `0` console/page errors while interactive gestures unlock full 8-bit chiptune SFX + Lyria BGM immediately.

---

void_audit_sections.heading: 8. IMPLEMENTATION
void_audit_sections.content:
- **Cleaned Assets (`assets/base_figure.png`, `assets/parts_4_hair_4_eyes_4_tops_4_bottoms.png`)**: Re-extracted directly from untouched `_raw.png` masters with zero studio-grey residue and trimmed `Cyan Wave`'s stray lower rat-tail (`y >= 194`).
- **`game/index.html`**:
  - Crisp `1280x720` (`imageSmoothingEnabled = false`) pixel-art Canvas renderer.
  - Multi-layer avatar compositor (`back hair curl -> bare/sleeved arms -> torso -> bottoms/boots -> jackets + pixel hands -> stepped lavender head -> face/lashes -> front hair wave -> over-hair spiked shades/visor -> diegetic equip sparks`).
  - Four-stage escalating spatial Nudge Card (`23% -> 47% -> 68% -> 85% more you`) culminating in the golden-ribbon `FINAL MATCH! / 89% MORE YOU / [PERFECT]` burst and the crackling vertical neon-lightning split reveal (`YOUR ORIGINAL` vs `AI RESTYLED`).
  - Lyria `bgm_loop.mp3` + WebAudio synthesized 8-bit browse blips, escalating nudge arpeggios, equip zaps, confetti fanfare, and lightning crackle.
  - Deterministic `window.__game.state` for automated playtesting (`?autostart`, `?seed=N`, `<link rel="icon" href="data:,">`).
- **`game/play.mjs`**:
  - Pure keyboard choreography (`ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight`, `Enter`, `KeyY`, `KeyK`) hitting all Omni video beats:
    - `t = 2.0s` (`pair_002.00.jpg`): Wearing `Blue Denim Jacket`, `HAIR` tab active, Slot 1 (`Cyan Wave`) sparkling hot-pink with `Try the cyan hair! / 47% more you` spatial nudge card.
    - `t = 5.0s` (`pair_005.00.jpg`): Full neon-drifted avatar (`Cyan Wave` + `Spiked Shades` + `Blue Denim Jacket` + `Cyber Heart Boots`), `BOTTOM` tab active, Slot 4 glowing hot-pink, golden-ribbon `FINAL MATCH! / 89% MORE YOU / [PERFECT]` burst with confetti.
    - `t = 8.0s` (`pair_008.00.jpg`): Full-screen vertical pink-white-cyan neon-lightning split comparing `YOUR ORIGINAL` vs `AI RESTYLED` amidst falling 8-bit confetti with chamfered `INFLUENCE 100%` badge at bottom center.
